我们充分理解并尊重网易游戏在其代理区的所有权，并尽可能保护其合法利益不受侵犯。 QuickShop-Hikari 作为 Mojang Minecraft 的社区拓展组件不被中国大陆法律认可和保护，且存在侵犯其专有利益的风险。 我们看到社区已有人收到了网易公司的律师信，或者遭到起诉，尽管直到目前（2023/02/13）还未见到有关官方正式文件，但我们有理由相信，在其最终用户许可协议的框架下，QuickShop-Hikari 有潜在风险违反其利益并有被滥用的危险。 因此，根据相关法律法规规定，我们采取了技术手段以避免我们的程序损害网易游戏的相关权益，以避免给我们自身带来相关的麻烦，包括但不限于： 基于 IP 地址探测，并在受保护区域内阻止 QuickShop-Hikari 的运行 QuickShop-Hikari 是一个 开放源码软件，任何人都可以 Fork 和修改它。 我们无权要求其他人不要 Fork 或不修改我们的软件。 因此，上述限制只适用于QuickShop-Hikari团队的官方下载渠道。 如果您正在运行一个 Fork 或修改版本， 请联系 Fork 或修改后的版本的作者，QuickShop-Hikari 对此不承担任何责任。 因此，上述限制仅对官方渠道分发的 QuickShop-Hikari 插件有效。 若你使用的版本经过修改，请联系其作者，QuickShop-Hikari 对此不负任何责任。

When using QuickShop-Hikari, some features communicate with external service providers. Some of these services are required when you explicitly use a feature, while others can be disabled through QuickShop-Hikari or the service's own configuration.

QuickShop-Hikari uses bStats.org to collect anonymous statistical metrics that help us understand how QuickShop-Hikari is being used and improve the project. You can review: bStats Privacy Policy QuickShop-Hikari's public bStats statistics

QuickShop-Hikari provides privacy-category controls for its bStats metrics: # Privacy Controller allows you to turn on/off options related to privacy. # To audit privacy-related activity, execute `/quickshop paste` # and check the Privacy Logs section. # To opt out of bStats completely, use /plugins/bStats/config.yml. privacy: type: # Includes bStats metrics with the `Statistic - ` prefix. STATISTIC: true # Includes bStats metrics with the `Research - ` prefix. RESEARCH: true Setting either category to false disables QuickShop-Hikari metrics belonging to that category. To disable bStats completely for the server, use the global bStats configuration at: /plugins/bStats/config.yml QuickShop-Hikari respects the global bStats configuration and will not submit bStats data when bStats has been globally disabled. note Disabling metrics prevents future submissions. Data that has already been submitted to bStats is controlled by bStats and is not automatically deleted when metrics are disabled.

QuickShop-Hikari uses Rollbar for automated error reporting. When enabled, errors related to QuickShop-Hikari may be submitted to Rollbar to help diagnose crashes and other unexpected behavior. See the Rollbar Privacy Policy. Submitted diagnostic information may include: 时间 Error and stack trace Operating system name Operating system architecture Operating system version System CPU core count Java version Server/Bukkit build version Server player information Online-mode status QuickShop-Hikari unique ID

A random QuickShop-Hikari instance ID is generated for a fresh installation and stored in config.yml. The ID is randomly generated and is not calculated from other identifying information. It is used for scenarios where QuickShop-Hikari needs to distinguish between different plugin installations, including diagnostics and error tracking. If you are certain that no addon or integration depends on the existing value, removing the ID from the configuration allows QuickShop-Hikari to generate a new one.

Automatic error reporting can be disabled in config.yml: # Should QS be allowed to automatically report errors to the author? # It will also create a paste for data-recovery or debug when the server boots up. auto-report-errors: false note Disabling automatic error reporting prevents future automatic reports. Previously submitted information is not automatically removed from Rollbar.

When you execute: /quickshop paste QuickShop-Hikari creates diagnostic information that can be used for troubleshooting. An online paste is uploaded to Lucko's Bytebin. If you do not want the diagnostic information uploaded to an external paste service, use: /quickshop paste file This creates the paste locally instead. QuickShop-Hikari attempts to censor sensitive information while generating diagnostic pastes. You should still review diagnostic information and only share paste links with people you trust.

QuickShop-Hikari can contact an external update provider to determine whether a newer version of the plugin is available. The updater can be disabled in config.yml: # Should QS be allowed to check for updates? updater: false When disabled, QuickShop-Hikari does not perform its normal automatic update checks.

Starting with QuickShop-Hikari 6.3.0.0, the updater is provider-based instead of being tied exclusively to the CodeMC Nexus service. The active update source is configured with: # The source to check for updates on. # Allowed values: "nexus", "modrinth" # Nexus shows snapshots and releases, modrinth shows releases only. updater-source: "modrinth" Available providers are: Provider Purpose modrinth Checks QuickShop-Hikari releases through the Modrinth API. nexus Checks the Nexus repository and can include snapshots and releases. info The selected updater provider determines which external service QuickShop-Hikari contacts while checking for updates.

When: updater-source: "modrinth" QuickShop-Hikari uses the Modrinth API to retrieve version metadata. The updater uses semantic-version comparison to determine the latest available release and latest stable release. Modrinth provides release versions only through this updater provider.
When: updater-source: "nexus" QuickShop-Hikari uses the Nexus update provider. Unlike the Modrinth provider, Nexus can expose both snapshot and release versions.

The centralized updater caches retrieved update metadata for one hour. This reduces repeated requests to the configured update service when multiple parts of QuickShop-Hikari request update information during that period.
QuickShop-Hikari's paste output includes the active update provider. This helps maintainers understand whether an installation is using: modrinth or: nexus when reviewing diagnostic information.

The 6.3.0.0 updater refactor introduced: Modrinth update-source support; the UpdateProvider interface for extensible update sources; a centralized UpdateManager; a one-hour metadata cache; unified semantic-version comparison; provider information in diagnostic paste output; provider-based update URLs; migration of UpdateWatcher to the generic updater system. From a privacy perspective, the important change is that update checks are no longer necessarily sent to the Nexus service. The external service contacted for update metadata depends on the configured updater-source. To prevent QuickShop-Hikari from performing update checks entirely, disable the updater: updater: false

QuickShop-Hikari Dialog is a third-party addon that replaces QuickShop-Hikari's default shop interactions with Paper dialog UIs. Third-party addon This addon is not bundled with QuickShop-Hikari. Support, releases, and issue tracking are handled by the addon's developer.

QuickShop-Hikari Dialog provides dialog-based interfaces for: creating shops; editing existing shops; buying from and selling to shops. It integrates with QuickShop-Hikari's interaction system instead of replacing QuickShop's shop logic or permissions.
The current published version requires: Dependency Version Java 25 or later Paper 1.21.11 or later QuickShop-Hikari 6.2.0.11 or later
MiniPlaceholders can be installed to provide audience and global placeholder tags inside the addon's translation messages.

Download QuickShop-Hikari Dialog from Modrinth. Place the addon jar in your server's plugins/ directory. Make sure QuickShop-Hikari is installed. Start the server once so the addon can generate: plugins/QuickShop-Hikari-Dialog/config.conf and its default translation files. Configure QuickShop-Hikari's interaction.yml to use the dialog behaviors.

The addon registers three QuickShop interaction behaviors: Behavior Description SHOP_CREATE_DIALOG Opens the shop creation dialog when assigned to a supported interaction SHOP_EDIT_DIALOG Opens the dialog for modifying an existing shop TRADE_DIALOG Opens the dialog for buying from or selling to an existing shop These behaviors can be assigned to QuickShop-Hikari interaction actions just like built-in interaction behaviors.

A recommended configuration is: STANDING_LEFT_CLICK_SIGN: TRADE_DIALOG STANDING_RIGHT_CLICK_SIGN: SHOP_EDIT_DIALOG STANDING_LEFT_CLICK_SHOPBLOCK: TRADE_DIALOG STANDING_RIGHT_CLICK_SHOPBLOCK: NONE # Reserved for opening the chest STANDING_LEFT_CLICK_CONTAINER: SHOP_CREATE_DIALOG STANDING_RIGHT_CLICK_CONTAINER: NONE The behavior identifiers can be reassigned to other interaction actions depending on your server's preferred workflow. See the QuickShop-Hikari interaction documentation for the full list of configurable interaction targets.

The addon provides the following permissions: Permission Description Default qshdialog.command.qshdialog.reload Reloads the addon's configuration and translations OP qshdialog.command.shopdialog.create Allows use of /shopdialog create true qshdialog.command.shopdialog.edit Allows use of /shopdialog edit true qshdialog.command.tradedialog Allows use of /tradedialog true QuickShop-Hikari's own shop permissions continue to determine which actions and dialog inputs are available to each player.
QuickShop-Hikari Dialog provides custom MiniMessage-style tags for use in its translation messages.

When a message has a shop context, the addon provides tags including: <shop:name> <shop:name_or:[fallback]> <shop:owner_name> <shop:owner_balance> <shop:owner_balance_formatted> <shop:price> <shop:price_formatted> <shop:trade_type> <shop:currency> <shop:stock> <shop:space> <shop:display> <shop:unlimited_stock> <shop:product_id> <shop:product_name> <shop:product_display_name>
Messages with an audience can use: <player_name> <player_display_name> <player_balance> <player_balance_formatted>
<shop_count:[player]> <shop_count_max:[player]>

The addon can expose QuickShop shop fees in translations: <shop_fee:create:(player)> <shop_fee:create_formatted:(player)> <shop_fee:change_name:(player)> <shop_fee:change_name_formatted:(player)> <shop_fee:change_price:(player)> <shop_fee:change_price_formatted:(player)>
Price limits can be queried using a namespaced item key: <price:[item_id]:min> <price:[item_id]:max> For example: <price:minecraft:diamond:min>

The addon can also render QuickShop-Hikari translation messages from within its own translation files using: <quickshop:key> or: <quickshop:key:arg0:arg1> Arguments are parsed as MiniMessage, allowing other addon tags to be nested inside them.
Download on Modrinth Source code and issue tracker links are available from the addon's Modrinth page.
QuickShop Reremake 和 Hikari spigot的附加插件。 在游戏中添加一个 /finditem 命令，用于搜索服务器上的所有商店。

在购买/销售商店中搜索商品 按不同类型搜索项目 支持基于查询的项目搜索 支持自定义项目的自定义模型数据 可配置的商店排序方式 显示物品携带的附魔 若物品包含 hide_enchants 标签，则隐藏其携带的附魔 显示药水效果 在搜索列表中隐藏某些商店 支持安全传送到商店（可在 config.yml 中配置） 忽略缺货的商店 支持世界黑名单（黑名单中的商店在搜索结果中被忽略） Config.yml 中的所有消息都支持十六进制码，因此您可以自定义颜色。

quickshopaddon.discount.use (默认: 所有人) 允许使用任何 /quickshop discount 命令的权限。 quickshopaddon.discount.bypass (默认: OP) 允许绕过权限检查，强制修改、删除优惠码。 quickshopaddon.discount.create.server_all_shops (默认：OP) 创建范围为 “服务器上任何人的所有商店” 的优惠码权限。 quickshopaddon.discount.create.player_all_shops (默认：所有人) 创建范围为 “优惠码创建者拥有的所有的商店” 的优惠码权限。 quickshopaddon.discount.create.specific_shops (默认：所有人) 创建范围为 “优惠码所指定的商店” 的优惠码权限。
若要创建一个优惠码，请使用 discount 命令： /quickshop discount create <code> <code-type> <rate> [最大使用次数] [门槛价格] [过期时间] 命令可能比较长，但你有一个命令助手来帮助你补全指令。
SERVER_ALL_SHOPS (可应用到服务器上任何人的任何商店) PLAYER_ALL_SHOPS (可应用到优惠码创建者所拥有的所有商店) SPECIFIC_SHOPS (生效于通过命令 /quickshop discount config <code> addshop 添加的商店)

通过使用 info 子命令, 你可以查询优惠码创建者、适用范围、剩余使用次数、过期时间、最低使用门槛和折扣率。 /quickshop discount info

info Can't find where to download the JAR? Click here. DyeSigns is an official QuickShop-Hikari addon that allows players to customize the appearance of their shop signs using normal Minecraft items. With DyeSigns installed, players can: change the text color of their shop sign with dyes; toggle glowing sign text with a Glow Ink Sac; clear DyeSigns-added effects from a shop sign; grant trusted shop staff permission to manage these effects. DyeSigns was added for QuickShop-Hikari 6.3.0.0.

Install DyeSigns like any other QuickShop-Hikari addon. Download the DyeSigns addon JAR. Place it in your server's plugins directory. Make sure QuickShop-Hikari is installed. Restart the server. DyeSigns depends on: QuickShop-Hikari The addon declares Folia support.

To change the text color of a shop sign: Hold a Minecraft dye. Right-click the QuickShop sign. For example: Red Dye makes the sign text red. Blue Dye makes the sign text blue. Lime Dye makes the sign text lime. Black Dye makes the sign text black. DyeSigns supports the normal Minecraft dye colors. The player must have: quickshopaddon.dyesigns.dye This permission is granted by default.

To toggle glowing text: Hold a Glow Ink Sac. Right-click the QuickShop sign. The glow state is toggled each time the sign is clicked with a Glow Ink Sac. The player must have: quickshopaddon.dyesigns.glow This permission is granted by default.

DyeSigns can clear the custom effects it has stored for a shop sign. To clear the effects: Hold a sign item. Right-click the QuickShop sign. For example: Oak Sign Spruce Sign Birch Sign and other materials whose item name contains _SIGN can trigger the clear action. The player must have: quickshopaddon.dyesigns.clear This permission is granted by default. Clearing removes the stored DyeSigns color and glow state and disables glowing text.

Having the global DyeSigns permission does not automatically allow a player to modify another player's shop. For a shop they do not own, the player must either: be authorized through the shop's DyeSigns staff permission; or have the corresponding .other permission. DyeSigns registers three per-shop staff permissions: sign-dye sign-glow sign-clear These are registered with QuickShop's STAFF permission group. This allows shop owners to grant trusted shop staff access to sign customization without giving them global administrative permissions.

Permission Default Description quickshopaddon.dyesigns.dye Everyone Allows a player to dye shop signs they are authorized to modify quickshopaddon.dyesigns.dye.other OP Allows dyeing other players' shop signs without shop authorization quickshopaddon.dyesigns.glow Everyone Allows a player to toggle glowing text on authorized shop signs quickshopaddon.dyesigns.glow.other OP Allows toggling glow on other players' shop signs without shop authorization quickshopaddon.dyesigns.clear Everyone Allows a player to clear DyeSigns effects from authorized shop signs quickshopaddon.dyesigns.clear.other OP Allows clearing DyeSigns effects from other players' shop signs without shop authorization note The .other permissions bypass the normal owner/per-shop authorization check for that DyeSigns action.

DyeSigns stores its customization directly on the sign using Minecraft's Persistent Data Container. The addon stores: the selected dye color; the glowing-text state; whether DyeSigns effects have been explicitly cleared. This allows DyeSigns to restore the customization when QuickShop updates the sign. For example, changing: the shop price; the shop item; the shop type; other information rendered on the sign can cause QuickShop to redraw the sign. DyeSigns listens for QuickShop's ShopSignUpdateEvent and reapplies the saved dye and glow state after these updates.

DyeSigns does not replace QuickShop's sign layout system. The normal QuickShop layout still controls what information appears on the sign: shop: layout: SELLING: line1: "header" line2: "trading" line3: "item" line4: "price" DyeSigns changes the Minecraft sign's visual text color and glowing-text state. For information about changing the contents of shop signs, see Sign Layout.
documents.s: How DyeSigns Interacts with Sign Layouts

documents.t: DyeSigns operates on QuickShop wall signs attached to a shop container. Right-clicking an unrelated sign does nothing. The addon verifies that: the clicked block is a wall sign; the sign is attached to a block; the attached block belongs to a QuickShop; the player is authorized to perform the requested action.

DyeSigns currently requires no user-facing feature configuration. Its configuration file contains only the configuration version: config-version: 2 Behavior is controlled through: Minecraft items; Bukkit permissions; QuickShop's per-shop staff permission system.

A normal server can usually leave the default permissions unchanged. Players automatically receive: quickshopaddon.dyesigns.dye quickshopaddon.dyesigns.glow quickshopaddon.dyesigns.clear Operators receive the .other permissions by default. If you use a permissions plugin, you can separately control administrative access: quickshopaddon.dyesigns.dye.other quickshopaddon.dyesigns.glow.other quickshopaddon.dyesigns.clear.other

DyeSigns adds lightweight visual customization to QuickShop signs while keeping QuickShop's normal sign renderer intact. Action Item Permission Change text color Any Minecraft dye quickshopaddon.dyesigns.dye Toggle glowing text Glow Ink Sac quickshopaddon.dyesigns.glow Clear DyeSigns effects Sign item quickshopaddon.dyesigns.clear Customizations are stored on the sign and automatically reapplied when QuickShop updates the sign.

此限制类型允许按特定时间间隔重置每个人的配额。 限制玩家每月最多购买 32 件物品： /quickshop limit set 32 /quickshop limit period MONTH 该系统基于QuickShop-Hikari日历系统。 时间使用 “值变化” 更新系统进行更新，这意味着 2022-12-31 到 2023-01-01 也被视为一年，且同时会更新月、周、日、小时、分钟、秒的限制。 其余的也都一样。 可用时间单位： SECOND - 1 秒 出于性能考虑而删除。 所有现存的按秒规则都会强制转为按分规则。 MINUTE - 1分钟 HOUR - 1 小时 DAY -1 天 WEEK - 1 周 MONTH - 1 个月 YEAR - 1年 由于 QuickShop-Hikari 的日历计时系统的限制，无法设置其他值（例如，3天）。

info Can't find where to download the JAR? Click here. QuickShop-Hikari includes an optional addon for Pl3xMap that displays QuickShop shops as markers on the web map. The addon creates a dedicated QuickShop layer and automatically registers it for Pl3xMap worlds.

The Pl3xMap addon: creates a QuickShop-Hikari Shops layer; displays QuickShop shops as map markers; supports configurable marker labels and details; supports a configurable marker icon; refreshes shop markers on a timer; registers and unregisters map layers as worlds load and unload.
Install the addon alongside: QuickShop-Hikari; Pl3xMap. The addon is packaged separately from the main QuickShop-Hikari jar. No additional QuickShop core configuration is required.

The addon creates its own config.yml. The current default configuration is: config-version: 1 # If you want the marker set/markers to display by default when opening the map. display-by-default: true # The name for the map layer layer-name: "QuickShop-Hikari Shops" # The priority for the map layer layer-priority: 99 # Should we show the controls for the layer? layer-controls: true # Should we use a custom icon for the marker? # If enabled, place the image in the qsaddon-pl3xmap data folder # and include the file extension in icon-file-location. icon-custom: false # Location for the image used as the QuickShop marker. icon-file-location: "players" # Max distance where users can see the marker. max-distance: 1000 # Marker label. # Placeholders: # %item%, %price%, %stock%, %owner%, %type%, %location% marker-label: "%item%, %price%, %stock%, %owner%, %type%" # Popup text displayed when clicking the marker. marker-detail: 'Chest Shop
Owner: %owner%
Item: %item%
Price: %price%
Stock: %stock%
Type: %type%
Location: %location%' # How many times per second the addon refreshes chest shops. refresh-per-seconds: 5
display-by-default: true Controls whether the QuickShop map layer is enabled when the addon starts. If disabled, the addon does not register the Pl3xMap event handlers or world layers.
layer-name: "QuickShop-Hikari Shops" Controls the display name of the map layer.
layer-priority: 99 Controls the layer priority inside Pl3xMap.
layer-controls: true Controls whether Pl3xMap shows layer controls for the QuickShop layer.

The addon can use a custom icon: icon-custom: false icon-file-location: "players" When icon-custom is enabled, QuickShop attempts to load the configured image from the addon data folder and register it with Pl3xMap. If the image cannot be loaded, the addon logs a warning.
max-distance: 1000 Controls the maximum map distance at which shop markers are displayed. Reducing this can help reduce the number of markers rendered at once on maps with many shops.
The marker label supports: %item% %price% %stock% %owner% %type% %location% For example: marker-label: "%item% - %price%" The same values can be used in marker-detail.

marker-detail controls the popup content displayed when a user clicks a shop marker. It accepts HTML-style content. For example: marker-detail: '%item%
Owner: %owner%
Price: %price%'
refresh-per-seconds: 5 Controls how frequently the addon refreshes shop marker data.

The addon automatically handles Pl3xMap worlds. When Pl3xMap finishes loading, QuickShop registers the shop layer for all available worlds. When a new world loads, the layer is registered for that world. When a world unloads, the QuickShop layer and its cached markers for that world are removed.
The Pl3xMap addon does not add player-facing permissions.

The Pl3xMap addon provides a live QuickShop map layer with configurable: layer name; layer priority; controls; custom marker icon; marker visibility distance; marker labels; marker popup details; refresh interval.

info 找不到在哪里下载 JAR 文件？ 点击这里。 caution 该附属插件仍处于实验阶段，所以请在使用之前正确管理您的备份文件。 风险自行承担。 该附属添加了一个转换器，允许用户轻松地从 QuickShop-Reremake 转换到 QuickShop-Hikari。
info 请注意，如果您无法理解本教程的内容， 请加入我们的 Discord 频道或询问其他专业服务器所有者/操作者。
进行数据转换有风险，所以您最好创建所有数据的完整备份，包括世界数据的全备份。 数据库和插件文件夹，以便在转换失败时还原它们。

按照通常步骤设置 QuickShop-Hikari 和 Addon-Reremake-Migrator，确保QuickShop-Hikari, QuickShop-Reremake Addon-Reremake-Migrator 同时安装在服务器中。 然后配置QuickShop-Hikari的数据库设置。 如果QuickShop-Hikari 和 QuickShop-Reremake 正在使用相同的 MySQL 数据库。 您必须为 QuickShop-Hikari 设置不同的表前缀。 否则，两者的数据都将损坏，转换将失败。 配置文件中表前缀的路径为 database.prefix. 如果您使用的是 H2 数据库，则不需要这样做。
为了避免数据损坏，在进行数据转换时，服务器上不允许玩家(包括管理员) 在线，所有操作都将在控制台上进行。 如果玩家在服务器中，则无法开始转换。 转换开始后， 服务器将在数据转换过程中被锁定，任何玩家在数据转换过程中都不能加入服务器。 在数据转换结束时，不论转换是否成功。 服务器将被锁定，在服务器重新启动之前，任何玩家都无法加入服务器。

在控制台中执行命令： /quickshop-hikari:quickshop migratefromreremake (是否覆盖) (迁移日志) (overwrite) 是否覆盖: 当 Reremake 与 Hikari 商店在转换过程中发生冲突时, 是允许转换器用 Reremake 的数据覆盖冲突的 Hikari 存储。 可为 true 或 false (migratelogs) 迁移日志: 本插件是否一并转移 qs.log 交易日志(及其压缩文件)至新数据库？ 该功能尚处于测试阶段，后果自负。 当前仅支持迁移购买日志。 若要转移交易日志，请将在 config.yml 中将交易日志记录的存储类型切换为数据库。 /quickshop-hikari:quickshop: Quickshop-Hikari和QuickShop-Reremake同时安装，因此会出现命令注册问题。 此命令使用命名空间来解决命令被Reremake注册的问题。 以下是此命令的示例： /quickshop-hikari:quickshop migratefromreremake true false
执行命令后，转换立即开始。 转换器将把大多数功能的配置信息转换为 QuickShop-Hikari 格式。 转换所需的时间取决于您拥有的商店数量、处理器性能和数据库性能。 绝大多数数据和配置将被转换，但交易日志和交互行为不被支持。 转换后请再次检查配置文件，以确保所有配置都按预期转换。 如果没有，您可能需要手动配置它。
在转换完成后，QuickShop-Reremake 将被暂时禁用(但尚未卸载)。 您需要关闭服务器并删除 QuickShop-Reremake 和 Addon-Reremake-Migrator JAR 文件。 如果一切顺利，您的所有商店现在都将被QuickShop-Hikari接管，并将按预期正常工作。

info Can't find where to download the JAR? Click here. QuickShop-Hikari includes an optional addon for squaremap that displays QuickShop shops as markers on the squaremap web map. The addon creates a dedicated QuickShop layer for every squaremap-enabled world and keeps shop markers synchronized automatically.

The squaremap addon: creates a QuickShop-Hikari Shops layer; displays shops as map markers; includes a bundled QuickShop shop icon; supports configurable marker labels and tooltips; refreshes markers asynchronously on a configurable interval; registers and unregisters layers when worlds load and unload.
Install the addon alongside: QuickShop-Hikari; squaremap. The addon is packaged separately from the main QuickShop-Hikari jar. No additional QuickShop core configuration is required.

The addon creates its own config.yml. The current default configuration is: config-version: 1 # Enable or disable the squaremap layer layer-enabled: true # If you want the marker set/markers to display by default when opening the map. default-hidden: false # The name for the map layer layer-name: "QuickShop-Hikari Shops" # The priority for the map layer layer-priority: 99 # The z-index for the layer z-index: 250 # Should we show the controls for the layer? show-controls: true # Marker label # Available placeholders: # %item%, %price%, %stock%, %owner%, %type%, %location%, # %x%, %y%, %z%, %world% marker-label: "%item% - %price%" # Tooltip displayed when hovering over the marker marker-tooltip: |
QuickShop
Owner: %owner%
Item: %item%
Price: %price%
Stock: %stock%
Type: %type%
Location: %x%, %y%, %z%
# How many seconds between marker refreshes refresh-per-seconds: 5
layer-enabled: true Enables or disables the squaremap integration. When disabled, the addon does not register map layers or shop markers.
default-hidden: false Controls whether the QuickShop layer is hidden by default when users open squaremap.
layer-name: "QuickShop-Hikari Shops" Controls the display name of the QuickShop layer.
layer-priority: 99 Controls the layer's priority.
z-index: 250 Controls the stacking order of the QuickShop layer relative to other squaremap layers.
show-controls: true Controls whether the layer is shown in squaremap's layer controls.

The addon includes a bundled: shop_icon.png and registers it with squaremap as the QuickShop shop icon. Unlike the Pl3xMap addon, the current squaremap integration does not expose a custom icon path in its configuration.
Both the marker label and tooltip support: %item% %price% %stock% %owner% %type% %location% %x% %y% %z% %world% For example: marker-label: "%item% - %price%"

marker-tooltip controls the HTML shown when hovering over a QuickShop marker. Because it is a multiline YAML value, it can be customized with HTML markup. For example: marker-tooltip: | %item%
Owner: %owner%
Price: %price%
refresh-per-seconds: 5 Controls how frequently QuickShop refreshes the marker layer. The update task runs asynchronously using QuickShop's scheduler.

The addon registers its layer only for worlds that are enabled in squaremap. When a Bukkit world loads, QuickShop checks whether that world is available in squaremap and registers the layer if needed. When a world unloads, the corresponding QuickShop layer and cached marker data are removed. When the addon shuts down, it unregisters its map layers and cancels its scheduled tasks.
The squaremap addon does not add player-facing permissions.

The squaremap addon provides a live QuickShop map layer with configurable: layer visibility; default hidden state; layer name; priority; z-index; controls; marker label; marker tooltip; refresh interval. It also includes its own bundled QuickShop shop icon.

移除了部分标为弃用的方法与类。 更新了交互管理。 增强其灵活程度，并允许额外添加 涉及 InteractionBehavior 与 InteractionType 类。 InteractionType 类表明交互类型，如：STANDING_LEFT_CLICK_SIGN、STANDING_LEFT_CLICK_SHOP InteractionBehavior 则进一步解释 InteractionType 的行为，如 CONTROL_PANEL 和 TRADE_UI 新增 UserLimitCalculationEvent，允许对玩家使用自定义限制。 适用于限制玩家拥有的商店数量，或通过等级系统在不需要额外实现 RankLimiter 的情况下为不同等级的玩家设置不同的商店数量上限。 新增 ShopLayoutProvider 接口，及其默认实现。 允许商店使用自定义排版，进一步自定义界面。 允许开发者覆写默认的排版样式，编写自己的实现。 如何自行制作？ 首先，实现你需要注册 InteractionManager 的类： InteractionManager manager = QuickShop.getInstance().getInteractionManager(); manager.interaction(new MyTradeInteraction()); manager.behavior(new MyTradeBehavior()); 将部分 Apache Commons 调用改为可简单替代的内置 java 方法，节省了约 1100 毫秒/次方法的调用 弃用了 ShopType 常量，以及 ShopTypeEvent 事件。 改为新的 IShopType 接口与实现类。 新事件为 ShopTypeEnhancedEvent。 允许第三方附属新增商店类型， 简化翻译代码检查。 更新配置系统，采用增强的 yaml 格式 允许配置文件自动更新而无需编写复杂脚本 允许配置系统不依赖 minecraft 本身。 将逻辑上的 PaperLib 替换为了原生 PaperAPI 调用。

修复价格限制相关问题（感谢 maxcom1 的贡献） 修复 1.20.x protocollib 展示相关问题（感谢 YuanYuanOwO 的贡献） 修复 itemdebug 手中无物品时的问题（感谢 YuanYuanOwO 的贡献） 修复 dominion 附属相关问题（感谢 YuanYuanOwO 的贡献） 新增简单检查避免此问题。 若非此商店拥有者，则直接拒绝限制请求。（感谢 YuanYuanOwO 的贡献） 修复 TranscationBuilder 不设置价格税收导致的 NPE（感谢 maxcom1 的贡献） 修复 /quickshop suggestprice 无法区分购买/出售类型商店的问题。 （感谢 MidSpike 的贡献） 修复使用 ProtocolLib 时报 PacketEvents ClassNotFoundException 的问题（感谢 wling-art 的贡献） 重新分配区块状态访问权限以创建商店（感谢 r00tbeerman 的贡献） 修复 SLF4J StaticLoggerBinder 载入错误（感谢 wling-art 的贡献） 通过验证告示牌方向修复了告示牌劫持问题（感谢 wling-art 的贡献） 优化性能，防止 QuickShop 在特定情况下卡死。 修复 1.20.4 packetevents 下虚拟展示物品不会保持显示的问题。 修复 GriefPrevention 兼容插件的重要问题。 修复收益启用后商店拥有者不会收到钱款的问题。 修复 Folia 侧的 Lands 支持，出于 Folia 兼容性考虑，使用了 regionThread（感谢 YuaskiDev 的贡献） 修复堆叠商店的 TRADE_DIRECT 相关问题 修复 protocollib 5.4.0 未记录包更新的相关问题 修复物品可以超出堆叠限制创建商店的问题。 修复 1.21.11 上与 BukkitAudiences 相关的崩溃问题。 修复商店删除相关问题。 修复商店被非拥有者持有后转让的权限检查问题。 （感谢 YuanYuanOwO 的贡献） 修复了菜单界面（感谢 YuanYuanOwO 的贡献） 修复非调试模式下日志相关问题。 修复 /qs find 命令相关问题。 修复配置加载时间过长相关问题。 修复配置载入/创建警告消息相关问题。 修复命令描述语言键名不匹配的问题（感谢 wling-art 的贡献） 修复 folia 上 qs clean 命令的相关问题（感谢 wling-art 的贡献） 修复 folia 上 per-player-shop-sign 的相关问题（感谢 wling-art 的贡献） 修复虚拟展示发包相关潜在的递归死锁问题（感谢 wling-art 的贡献） 修复配置载入/创建警告消息相关问题。 修复 /qs browse 与 ShopItemOnly 附属在 folia 上的兼容性问题。 修复 Plan 使用了过时 API 的问题。 修复 folia 上 qs clean 命令的相关问题（感谢 wling-art 的贡献） 修复 folia 上 /qs cleanghost 命令的相关问题（感谢 wling-art 的贡献） folia 上更多的线程安全性修复（感谢 wling-art 的贡献） 修复拥有者支付计算收益相关问题（感谢 wling-art 的贡献）

初步实现 Folia 支持 新增 CONTROL_PANEL_UI 交互，允许使用菜单控制界面而非聊天栏。 在这个界面中你可以添加店员、转让商店、设置商店交易模式、修改价格以及删除商店！ 重新添加了 QS 历史界面 移除了真实物品与实体展示功能；相较虚拟展示毫无优势且存在漏洞。 若 protocollib 非最新版本或未安装，则默认不显示。 新增 /qs browse [世界名称] 命令，允许玩家浏览全服或指定世界内的商店 新增 TRADE_UI 交互，可打开交易菜单，用于购买/出售物品，还可自选数量。 更新对 MC 1.21.3 与 1.21.4 的支持。 新增 VaultUnlocked 支持

新增两种即将到来的交互行为。 CONTROL_PANEL_UI 与 TRADE_UI 当税费设置为 0 时不弹出相关消息。 新增 /qs staffall 命令，可用于管理所有商店的店员。 新增“冻结”模式。 允许管理员/店员临时禁止商店交易 该模式可在商店管理菜单中浏览。 该模式亦被加入聊天栏设置菜单中。 该模式增加了两条新命令：/qs silentfreeze 与 /qs freeze 现在，若没有看向商店，则 /qs suggestprice 的默认对象调整为手中的物品。 新增 shop.finding.global 权限，可忽略 /qs find 命令的距离限制 现在组成商店的告示牌会被默认打蜡以防止其他玩家的更改（感谢 ThiagoROX 的贡献） 新增 SignOpen 监听器（感谢 ThiagoROX 的贡献） 新增子命令覆盖（感谢 ThiagoROX 的贡献）
新增样式指导教程。 尽可能新增了最终内部代码。 取消设置商店名称时会调用 ShopNamingEvent 了。 新增 ShopUnlimitedStatusEvent 事件，会在商店切换无限库存时触发。 将事件重排为了不同的包。 会导致依赖于事件的插件无法正常工作。

documents.t: 关于： 模块化且灵活的 Minecraft 虚拟物品发包管理工具。 支持 ProtocolLib 与 PacketEvents 插件。 自定义包工厂： 1.20.x 与 1.21.x PacketFactory 的模块化实现。 包类型： 生成包：在指定位置生成虚拟物品实体。 元数据包：更新虚拟物品的可视化数据。 速度包：向实体添加动量/速度（当前可选）。 销毁包：在客户端视角下移除实体。 错误处理与记录： 增强了调试日志，使其可追踪发包相关问题。 缺失工厂类或未注册监听器的详细错误消息。 改进：​ 更好的模块化设计，实现对未来版本 Minecraft 的支持。 弃用：​ 旧的发包处理机制将会被新的发包系统替代。

event/Phase.java - 引入基于阶段的事件系统，用于检查事件过程的不同阶段。 event/PhasedEvent.java - 设置不同阶段的事件，允许更优的事件状态管理。 发包处理事件：​ event/packet/handler/PacketHandlerAddedEvent.java - 在系统内注册新发包处理器时调用。 event/packet/handler/PacketHandlerInitEvent.java - 在发包处理器初始化时调用，可用于调试或自定义安装。 event/packet/send/PacketHandlerSendDestroyEvent.java - 数据包指导客户端视角的实体销毁时触发。 event/packet/send/PacketHandlerSendMetaEvent.java - 实体元数据通过发包发送时触发。 event/packet/send/PacketHandlerSendSpawnEvent.java - 在实体通过发包交流生成时触发。 商店事件​ ShopUpdateEvent 被替换为 ShopDatabaseEvent ShopAuthorizeEvent 被替换为 ShopPermissionCheckEvent ShopClick、ShopCreate、ShopDelete、ShopLoad 被分别替换为名称相似的事件，现位于 event.management 包，且为阶段事件。 商店设置事件：​ event/settings/ShopSettingEvent.java - 处理商店设置动态修改的事件。 event/settings/package-info.java - 包含元数据的商店设置文档包。 商店类型相关设置：​ event/settings/type/ShopCurrencyEvent.java - 处理商店内使用的货币类型更改。 event/settings/type/ShopDisplayEvent.java - 在商店的展示设置（如悬浮字、告示牌等）更改时触发。 event/settings/type/ShopItemEvent.java - 在商店内出售的物品更新时触发。 event/settings/type/ShopNameEvent.java - 在商店名称更新时触发。 event/settings/type/ShopOwnerEvent.java - 负责管理商店转让与更改相关内容。 event/settings/type/ShopOwnerNameEvent.java - 拥有者名称发生变化时触发。 event/settings/type/ShopPlayerGroupEvent.java - 处理玩家组与商店相关的更新。 event/settings/type/ShopPriceEvent.java - 商店内物品价格变化时触发。 event/settings/type/ShopSignLinesEvent.java - 负责管理商店告示牌显示内容相关更新。 event/settings/type/ShopTaxAccountEvent.java - 在商店税收账户更新时触发。 event/settings/type/ShopTypeEvent.java - 负责记录商店分类或类型的改动。 event/settings/type/ShopUnlimitedEvent.java - 负责处理商店无限库存状态相关设置。 商店优惠系统：​ event/settings/type/benefit/ShopBenefitAddEvent.java - 在商店增加新优惠（折扣或老用户回馈等）时触发。 event/settings/type/benefit/ShopBenefitEvent.java - 负责处理商店优惠变动相关事件。 event/settings/type/benefit/ShopBenefitRemoveEvent.java - 在商店优惠被移除时触发。

event/details/ShopItemChangeEvent.java - 替换为 ShopItemEvent.java 确保结构连贯性。 event/details/ShopNamingEvent.java - 并入 ShopNameEvent.java。 event/details/ShopOwnerNameGettingEvent.java - 替换为 ShopOwnerNameEvent.java。 event/details/ShopOwnershipTransferEvent.java - 现交由 ShopOwnerEvent.java 处理。 event/details/ShopPlayerGroupSetEvent.java - 并入 ShopPlayerGroupEvent.java。 event/details/ShopPriceChangeEvent.java - 并入 ShopPriceEvent.java。 event/details/ShopTypeChangeEvent.java - 替换为 ShopTypeEvent.java。 event/details/ShopUnlimitedStatusEvent.java - 现通过 ShopUnlimitedEvent.java 管理。 event/display/ShopDisplayItemDespawnEvent.java - 因 ShopDisplayEvent.java 移除。 event/display/ShopDisplayItemSafeGuardEvent.java - 并入更宽泛的显示事件分类。 event/economy/ShopTaxAccountChangeEvent.java - 现囊括于 ShopTaxAccountEvent.java。 event/economy/ShopTaxAccountGettingEvent.java - 因重构商店经济系统而被弃用。 event/packet/PacketHandlerAddedEvent.java - 移动至 event/packet/handler/PacketHandlerAddedEvent.java。 event/packet/PacketHandlerInitEvent.java - 交由 event/packet/handler/PacketHandlerInitEvent.java 处理。
event/AbstractQSEvent.java - 基于事件结构更新，以支持阶段事件执行。 event/QSCancellable.java - 添加了新的取消条件，防止非预期的事件结束。 包事件：​ event/package-info.java - 更新以反映新的事件结构。 事件/数据包/acketHandlerEvent.java - 现在支持额外的数据包处理场景。

These displays don't require packetevents or protocollib. They are more performant than the previous display types. They are also more flexible and can be used for other purposes. They can be scaled using the new display-scale configuration They can be configured to allow intearactions in interaciton.yml, the options are: STANDING_LEFT_CLICK_DISPLAY: NONE STANDING_RIGHT_CLICK_DISPLAY: NONE SNEAKING_LEFT_CLICK_DISPLAY: NONE SNEAKING_RIGHT_CLICK_DISPLAY: NONE
This uses worker-type: 3.

Updated matcher to store and compare DataComponentType.Valued entries. Resolved registry entries safely using the Paper data component registry. Implemented whitelist-based matching: only components explicitly enabled in matcher.components are compared. Merged previous meta toggles into components using uppercase group keys. Explicitly excluded CUSTOM_DATA from comparison to prevent ViaVersion protocol markers from causing mismatches.

Matching now: Handles null safety. Optionally checks material. Optionally checks stack amount. Iterates only over enabled component types. Returns false immediately on the first mismatch. Returns true if all enabled components match.

All comparisons are configured under matcher.components. Keys can be: Direct DataComponentTypeKeys fields (e.g., DAMAGE, LORE, ENCHANTMENTS). Group keys that expand internally (e.g., BOOKS, SHULKER_BOX, FIREWORK).

Added shop.text-display which is a visual display that can be customized. This is a more visually appealing version of shop.display-item-use-name. These support adventure lib components are are configurable through config.yml # This spawns a separate fake entity that displays shop information. text-display: # Should the text display be enabled? enabled: false # Text Display view range range-blocks: 3 # Height above the item y-offset: 0.8 # Background color (32-bit ARGB) background-color: 1073741824 line-width: 200 #The scale of the text display. #The acceptable values are from 0.0 to 1.0. scale: x: 0.5 y: 0.5 z: 0.5 # <item_name> is replaced with the item name. # <price> is replaced with the item price. # <amount> is replaced with the item amount. # <price_amount> is replaced with the item price per amount. # <owner> is replaced with the shop owner's name. # <type> is replaced with the shop type (BUYING/SELLING). # <status> is replaced with the shop status (ACTIVE/FROZEN). lines: - "<green><item_name></green>" - "<gray><owner></gray>" - "<gray><type></gray>" - "<gold><price_amount></gold>"

Added​ Modrinth update source support Uses Modrinth API for version checks Detects latest & latest stable release via SemVer New UpdateProvider interface for extensible update sources New centralized UpdateManager 1-hour metadata cache Unified version comparison Paste output now shows the active provider Changed​ Refactored old Nexus-only updater into a provider-based system UpdateWatcher now uses the generic updater manager Update URL now comes from the active provider Config​ #The source to check for updates on. #Allowed values: "nexus", "modrinth" #Nexus shows snapshots and releases, modrinth shows releases only. updater-source: "modrinth" This lays the groundwork for future providers (CurseForge, Hangar, GitHub, etc.) without core rewrites.
A new player-driven tagging system has been introduced, allowing players to organize and track shops using custom tags.

Players can add custom tags to shops they are looking at. Tags support letters, underscores (_), and dashes (-). Tags are normalized and limited in length to ensure consistency and performance. Reserved system tags power built-in features such as: @fav - Favorites @watch - Watchlist @avoid - Avoided shops Tags are stored per-player per-shop, allowing each player to maintain their own organization system.

/qs tag <tag> - Add a tag to the shop you are looking at /qs tag remove <tag> - Remove a tag from the current shop /qs tag clear - Remove all of your tags from the current shop /qs tag shops - List all tags you have created /qs tag tagged <tag> - List shops you have tagged with a specific tag /qs tag purge <tag> - Remove a tag from all shops /qs favorite - Add the current shop to your favorites /qs watch - Add the current shop to your watchlist /qs avoid - Add the current shop to your avoid list

The render component system replaces the current sign layout system and the text-display system, combining both into a single flexible rendering system. The layout options for signs retain the current iteration (header, trading, item, level, price), while introducing greater customization. Components are now divided into three categories: Full line components – occupy an entire sign line. Inline components – replace only themselves and can be combined with surrounding text. Conditional components – behave like inline components but automatically change their output based on the current shop state.
header – shop owner/availability header item – formatted item display level – item level/duration line price – complete price line with stacking shop support trading – trading/stock status line

<amount> – item amount <item_name> – item display name <item_level> – enchantment level, potion duration, or similar item metadata <owner> – shop owner name <price_alone> – formatted price only <price_amount> – formatted price text with stacking shop support <status> – current shop state/status <stock> – remaining stock display <type> – shop type (Buy/Sell/etc.)

Conditional components dynamically determine their output based on the current shop state. <amount_auto> – Displays: Out of Stock when the shop has no remaining stock. Unlimited when the shop has unlimited stock. The remaining stock amount when the shop has available stock.

info Can't find where to download the JAR? Click here. QuickShop-Hikari includes an official compatibility module for Bolt, the block protection plugin. The Bolt compatibility module prevents players from creating QuickShop shops on Bolt-protected containers that they are not allowed to access. Support was added in QuickShop-Hikari 6.3.0.0.

To use Bolt compatibility, install all three components: QuickShop-Hikari Bolt Compat-Bolt Place the compatibility module JAR in your server's plugins directory alongside QuickShop-Hikari and Bolt, then restart the server. The compatibility module declares both plugins as hard dependencies, so it will not load unless both are present. The module also declares Folia support.

When a player attempts to create a QuickShop, the compatibility module checks the shop container against Bolt before creation is allowed. The check runs during QuickShop's cancellable pre-creation phase. If the target block: is protected by Bolt; and cannot be accessed by the player according to Bolt; QuickShop cancels the shop creation. The player is prevented from creating a shop on that protected block.

QuickShop does not maintain a separate set of Bolt permissions. Instead, the compatibility module asks Bolt directly whether the player can access the protected block. This means Bolt remains the authority for deciding who may access the container. If Bolt considers the player authorized, QuickShop allows the normal shop-creation process to continue.

The compatibility module checks the block at the location where QuickShop is attempting to create the shop. If the block is not protected by Bolt, the compatibility module does not interfere. If the block is protected but the player has access through Bolt, shop creation is also allowed. Only a protected block that the player cannot access causes QuickShop creation to be cancelled.

The Bolt compatibility module currently focuses on shop creation protection. It listens to QuickShop's ShopCreateEvent during the PRE_CANCELLABLE phase and does not add separate handlers for: shop trading; changing shop prices; deleting shops; changing shop settings; normal container access. Those actions continue to be controlled by QuickShop, Bolt, Bukkit, and any other installed protection integrations as applicable. note Installing Compat-Bolt does not make QuickShop a replacement for Bolt's normal protection behavior. It specifically prevents unauthorized creation of a QuickShop on a Bolt-protected block.

Compat-Bolt does not currently provide its own configuration file or user-facing settings. Once the module, QuickShop-Hikari, and Bolt are installed, the integration works automatically. There are no QuickShop configuration values that need to be enabled for the Bolt creation check.

Compat-Bolt does not register its own player permission nodes. Authorization is determined using Bolt's API: Is the block protected? Can this player access it? Server administrators should therefore configure access through Bolt itself.

If a player can create a shop on a container you expected Bolt to protect, verify that: Bolt is installed and enabled; Compat-Bolt is installed and enabled; QuickShop-Hikari is installed and enabled; Bolt actually reports the target container as protected; Bolt's access rules do not already grant that player access. If a player is blocked from creating a shop, check their Bolt access to the target container first.

Compat-Bolt provides a focused integration between QuickShop-Hikari and Bolt: Situation Result Block is not protected by Bolt Shop creation continues Block is protected and player has Bolt access Shop creation continues Block is protected and player does not have Bolt access Shop creation is cancelled No additional QuickShop configuration or compatibility-specific permissions are required.

info 找不到在哪里下载 JAR 文件？ 点击这里。 附属新增了 QuickShop 与 Dominion 之间的联动兼容。 它可以确保商店创建兼容 Dominion 的领地保护功能。
Dominion 允许玩家或特定组别占领土地，设置基于领地的权限。 无兼容模块： 玩家可以无视土地保护，在别的区域里创建商店。 玩家可以在其他人的土地中与箱子商店自由交互。 Dominion 权限规则可能不会对商店交互生效。 Dominion 兼容附属确保： 创建商店前检查领地是否属于玩家。 商店交易跟随 Dominion 自身的权限设置。 无权限玩家不能与受保护区域的商店交易。
玩家试图： 创建商店 与商店交互 在商店交易 时，QuickShop 会检查： 商店所在位置是否属于 Dominion 插件设置的区域。 玩家是否拥有该区域的交互权限。 Dominion 设置规则中是否允许商店交互。 若 Dominion 的设置不允许交易操作，那么 QuickShop 就会阻止玩家。 若商店位置不属于任何 Dominion 领地，那么 QuickShop 的行为不会发生变化。
安装附属后： 领地拥有者可以创建或管理领地内的商店。 受信任的成员拥有相应的领地权限。 外来者未经许可前无法进行任何交易操作。 商店交易操作跟随 Dominion 的领地规则设置。 阻止其他玩家在受保护区域内创建商店。
安装 Dominion。 安装 QuickShop Dominion 兼容附属。 重启服务器。 附属插件会在 Dominion 安装时自动生效。 无需额外配置。
若有可配置项，它们会出现在模块的 config.yml 中。 示例选项可能如下： # 禁止商店在 Dominion 领地之外的区域创建 whitelist-mode: false # 允许领地拥有者覆盖商店权限 allow-owner-override: true 若未安装 Dominion，则附属不会生效。
对于正在使用 Dominion 插件的服务器： 将商店创建权限限制为仅拥有者与受信任玩家可用。 若有需要还可禁止非领地区域创建商店。 允许 Dominion 领地拥有者管理商店权限。 浏览 Dominion 权限设置，使其与商店的交易行为相适应。 以此保证保护区域有效与有序。
只有拥有对应 Dominion 权限时才可以。 否则的话，QuickShop 会阻止创建操作。

info Can't find where to download the JAR? Click here. QuickShop-Hikari includes an optional compatibility module for EcoEnchants. The integration allows QuickShop item previews to use EcoEnchants' own display formatting and registers EcoEnchants enchantment names with QuickShop's localization system.

Install the compatibility module alongside: QuickShop-Hikari EcoEnchants The module requires both plugins and is loaded automatically when they are present. No additional QuickShop configuration is required.
The EcoEnchants compatibility module provides two main integrations: EcoEnchants formatting in QuickShop item previews EcoEnchants enchantment translation-key mappings

QuickShop fires an item-preview event before an item is displayed to a player. When a player-specific preview is being prepared, the compatibility module clones the preview ItemStack and passes it through EcoEnchants' EnchantDisplay. This allows EcoEnchants-specific display information to be applied to the item that QuickShop presents to the player. The modified clone is then returned to QuickShop as the preview item. info The integration only applies EcoEnchants display formatting when the preview has an associated player.

The module also registers EcoEnchants enchantments with QuickShop's localized translation-key system. For every enchantment reported by EcoEnchants, QuickShop registers a key using this format: ecoenchants:enchantment.<enchantment-id> The key is mapped to the enchantment's raw display name from EcoEnchants. This allows QuickShop's item-name and component rendering systems to correctly resolve EcoEnchants enchantment names where those translation keys are used.

EcoEnchants translation mappings are refreshed when QuickShop's configuration is reloaded. The module also refreshes the mappings shortly after any of these plugins are enabled: EcoEnchants libreforge eco This helps ensure the available EcoEnchants enchantments have been initialized before QuickShop registers their translation mappings.

The EcoEnchants compatibility module does not provide its own configuration file. Once the compatibility module, QuickShop-Hikari, and EcoEnchants are installed, the integration operates automatically.
The module does not add any player-facing permissions.
The compatibility module requires: EcoEnchants QuickShop-Hikari

The EcoEnchants compatibility module makes EcoEnchants items display more naturally inside QuickShop by: applying EcoEnchants' display formatting to player-facing QuickShop item previews; registering EcoEnchants enchantment translation keys with QuickShop; refreshing those mappings when QuickShop reloads or relevant Eco plugins are enabled. There are no additional configuration options or permissions required.

info 找不到在哪里下载 JAR 文件？ 点击这里。 附属新增了 QuickShop 与 HuskTowns 之间的联动兼容。 确保商店的创建与交互跟随 HuskTowns 城镇与领地的权限。
HuskTowns 允许玩家创建城镇，占领土地。 无兼容模块： 玩家可以无视土地保护，在别的区域里创建商店。 玩家可以在其他人的土地中与箱子商店自由交互。 城镇的权限规则可能不会对商店交互生效。 HuskTowns 兼容附属确保： 创建商店前检查领地是否属于玩家。 交易遵循土地权限规则。 正确处理城镇成员与访客。 郊区商店创建限制仍然可以自由配置。
玩家试图： 创建商店 与商店交互 在商店交易 时，QuickShop 会检查： 商店所在位置是否属于 HuskTowns 城镇。 玩家是否属于城镇，受到城镇信任或只是外来者。 城镇的权限设置是否允许此操作。 若城镇规则的设置不允许交易操作，那么 QuickShop 就会阻止玩家。 城镇之外则使用 QuickShop 的默认行为，除非额外配置。
安装附属后： 城镇拥有者可以创建或管理城镇内的商店。 城镇成员跟随城镇权限设置。 外来者未经许可前无法进行任何交易操作。 商店交互跟随城镇保护。 阻止其他玩家在城镇区域内创建商店。
安装 HuskTowns。 安装 QuickShop HuskTowns 兼容附属。 重启服务器。 附属插件会在 HuskTowns 安装时自动生效。 无需手动配置。
若有可配置项，它们会出现在模块的 config.yml 中。 示例选项可能如下： # 禁止商店在城镇之外的区域创建 whitelist-mode: false # 允许城镇拥有者覆盖商店权限 allow-owner-override: true 若未安装 HuskTowns，则附属不会生效。
对于基于城镇的生存服务器： 限制只有城镇成员可以创建商店。 只在城镇权限允许的情况下进行交易。 若有需要还可禁止郊区创建商店。 启用拥有者覆盖，可以方便城镇拥有者管理城镇内的商店。 这有助于保持以城镇为基础的经济平衡。
只有拥有对应城镇权限时才可以。 否则的话，QuickShop 会阻止创建操作。

info 找不到在哪里下载 JAR 文件？ 点击这里。 ItemMatcherPlus 兼容附属改进了 QuickShop 匹配自定义与插件修改物品的方式。 一般情况下标准的 Bukkit 物品比较方法无法完美适配，这个附属允许 QuickShop 正确识别堆叠其他插件创建的物品。 这个附属适用于使用了如下内容的服务器： 自定义物品 修改元数据 基于 NBT 的系统 高级宝箱奖励 自定义酿造系统 自定义渔获物
默认的 Minecraft 匹配方法只检查： 材料类型 基本元数据 不过，许多插件都对物品的修改不止于此： 自定义 NBT 数据 隐藏标签 自定义描述格式 唯一标识符 无匹配增强的情况下： 物品无法正确堆叠 商店不能正确识别物品 交易可能失败 交易行为可能出现异常 ItemMatcherPlus 能够提升兼容性，以及物品匹配的准确性。
ItemMatcherPlus 内置了如下插件的支持： AdvancedItems BreweryX CrazyCrates ExcellentCrates PyroFishing SilkSpawners 若安装上述之一或多个插件，QuickShop 会自动使用增强的匹配逻辑。 无需额外配置。
当玩家与商店交易时： QuickShop 检查物品。 若启用 ItemMatcherPlus，则进行高级匹配。 验证插件添加的元数据信息。 物品确认匹配（或者安全拒收）。 这使得： 自定义物品正确堆叠 商店交易正常进行 准确的交易检测 减少错判概率
下载 ItemMatcherPlus 附属。 将 JAR 放入你的 plugins 文件夹中。 重启服务器。 如果检测到支持的插件，自动启用兼容。
ItemMatcherPlus 无需配置。 它在以下情况下自动激活： 本附属安装，且 支持插件已经安装 若支持的插件没有安装，那么附属功能不会激活。
ItemMatcherPlus 适用于服务器存在如下内容的情况： 自定义钓鱼插件 自定义酿造系统 带有修改物品的抽奖箱插件 自定义刷怪笼 任意修改了 NBT 数据的插件 未安装兼容的情况下，商店可能不会正确识别物品。

info Can't find where to download the JAR? Click here. QuickShop-Hikari includes an optional compatibility module for Reforges. The integration allows QuickShop item previews to use Reforges' own item display formatting, ensuring reforge information is represented when QuickShop prepares an item preview for a player.

Install the compatibility module alongside: QuickShop-Hikari Reforges The module requires both plugins and is loaded automatically when they are present. No additional QuickShop configuration is required.

The Reforges compatibility module integrates with QuickShop's item-preview system. Before QuickShop presents an item preview to a player, the module passes a cloned version of the preview item through Reforges' ReforgesDisplay. This allows Reforges-specific display information to be applied to the item shown by QuickShop. The formatted clone is then returned to QuickShop as the preview item.

The integration listens for QuickShop's: ItemPreviewComponentPrePopulateEvent When the event contains a player, the module: clones the preview ItemStack; applies the standard Reforges display processing; applies Reforges display processing using its display properties; replaces the QuickShop preview item with the formatted clone. info Reforges formatting is only applied when the QuickShop preview has an associated player.

The compatibility module works on a cloned preview ItemStack. It does not modify the actual item stored by the shop simply to display Reforges information. The integration is specifically part of QuickShop's player-facing item-preview rendering process.
The Reforges compatibility module does not provide its own configuration file. Once the compatibility module, QuickShop-Hikari, and Reforges are installed, the integration operates automatically.
The module does not add any player-facing permissions.
The compatibility module requires: Reforges QuickShop-Hikari

The Reforges compatibility module integrates Reforges with QuickShop's item-preview pipeline. Its purpose is to ensure that Reforges display information is applied to the item preview shown to players without modifying the shop's actual stored item. There are no additional configuration options or permissions required.

info 找不到在哪里下载 JAR 文件？ 点击这里。 附属新增了 QuickShop 与 UltimateClaims 之间的联动兼容。 确保商店的创建与交互跟随 UltimateClaims 拥有者与土地的权限。
在使用土地占领插件的服务器上，玩家可以通过这种方式保护土地不受破坏。 无兼容模块： 玩家可以无视土地保护，在别的区域里创建商店。 玩家可能在不该去的区域参与商店交易。 土地保护规则不会对商店生效。 UltimateClaims 兼容附属确保： 创建商店前检查土地是否属于玩家。 交易遵循土地权限规则。 土地拥有者能够管理领地之内的所有商店。
玩家试图： 创建商店 与商店交互 在商店交易 时，QuickShop 会检查： 商店所在位置是否属于某个土地。 玩家是否拥有该区域的交互权限。 设置规则中是否允许商店交互。 如果土地设置禁止玩家这么做，那么 QuickShop 会阻止它。 土地外区域适用 QuickShop 的默认行为。
安装附属后： 土地拥有者可以创建或管理领地内的商店。 受信任的成员拥有相应的领地权限。 其他玩家根据领地配置受到相应限制。 土地外的商店按一般情况处理。 阻止其他玩家在受保护区域内创建商店。
安装 UltimateClaims。 安装 QuickShop UltimateClaims 兼容附属。 重启服务器。 如果启动时检测到 UltimateClaims，兼容附属会自动激活。 无需额外设置。
若有可配置项，它们会出现在模块的 config.yml 中。 示例选项可能如下： # 禁止商店在土地之外的区域创建 whitelist-mode: false # 允许土地拥有者覆盖商店权限 allow-owner-override: true 若未安装 UltimateClaims，则附属不会生效。
对于使用土地功能的服务器： 限制只有土地成员可以创建商店。 允许土地成员在有权限的情况下交易。 若有需要还可禁止郊区创建商店。 启用拥有者覆盖功能还可以更好管理商店。 确保玩家能够管理受保护区域。
只有拥有对应土地权限时才可以。 否则的话，QuickShop 会阻止创建操作。

documents.t: info Can't find where to download the JAR? Click here. QuickShop-Hikari includes an optional compatibility module for VoidChest. The module prevents VoidChest from processing QuickShop display/guard items as normal dropped items. This protects QuickShop's display system from being accidentally sold or consumed by VoidChest.

Install the compatibility module alongside: QuickShop-Hikari VoidChest The module is packaged as: Compat-VoidChest Both VoidChest and QuickShop-Hikari are required dependencies, so the compatibility module should only be installed when both plugins are present.

QuickShop uses specially identified item stacks for parts of its display system. The VoidChest compatibility module listens to VoidChest's item-processing events and checks whether the item being processed is one of these QuickShop guard items. If it is, the VoidChest event is cancelled. This prevents QuickShop display items from being: processed as normal dropped items; sold through VoidChest's chunk-item selling system; otherwise consumed by the VoidChest item-processing flow handled by these events.
The compatibility module currently integrates with two VoidChest API events.
When VoidChest attempts to sell a dropped chunk item, QuickShop checks the dropped item's ItemStack. If the item is identified as a QuickShop guard item, the event is cancelled.
When VoidChest processes an item spawn, QuickShop checks either the Bukkit Item or the supplied ItemStack. If it is identified as a QuickShop guard item, the event is cancelled.

The compatibility check uses QuickShop's display-item protection system: AbstractDisplayItem.checkIsGuardItemStack(...) This means the module is specifically intended to stop VoidChest from interfering with item stacks that QuickShop has marked for its display system. Normal player items are not cancelled by this compatibility module simply because they are near a QuickShop shop.
The VoidChest compatibility module does not currently provide its own configuration file. Once installed with both required plugins, the integration is enabled automatically.
The compatibility module does not add any player-facing permissions.
The module requires: VoidChest QuickShop-Hikari It is built against the VoidChest API and registers its listeners directly with VoidChest's event manager.
The module declares Folia support: folia-supported: true

The VoidChest compatibility module is a small protection integration between QuickShop-Hikari and VoidChest. Its purpose is to ensure that QuickShop display/guard items are ignored by VoidChest's item selling and item-spawn processing systems, preventing those internal display items from being accidentally processed as normal items.
