documents.t: QuickShop-Hikari 支持两种数据库：H2 和 MySQL。

# 数据库配置 # QuickShop 支持： # - H2（本地文件存储；设置简单） # - MySQL（推荐大规模服务器或群众服使用） database: # false = 使用本地 H2 数据库 # true = 使用 MySQL 数据库 mysql: false # 数据库域名（只在 mysql 为 true 时需要填入） host: localhost # 数据库端口（只在 mysql 为 true 时需要填入） port: 3306 # 数据库名称（只在 mysql 为 true 时需要填入） database: quickshop # 数据库用户名（只在 mysql 为 true 时需要填入） user: root # 数据库密码（只在 mysql 为 true 时需要填入） password: passwd # 表前缀。设置为“none”表示不使用前缀。 # 每个服务器的表前缀不可相同。多个服务器不可共用一个表前缀。 prefix: qs_ # 数据库连接使用 SSL（只在 mysql 为 true 时需要填入） usessl: false # 禁用数据库内用户名缓存。 disable-username-cache: false # 启用 UUID 缓存，方便快速查询（高级） bake-uuids: false # 载入服务线程数量 # -1 = 自动选择推荐值 # 高级选项—只在了解线程优化时建议更改。 loader-threads: -1 # 在 /qs paste 输出中包含完整的数据库信息。 generate-full-report: false # 禁用保存时的关闭超时。 # 可能导致服务器关闭时挂起。 unlimited-save-wait: false # 跳过数据库/表版本检查。 # 禁用有风险；可能不会提供支持。 skip-version-check: false # 连接池设置（HikariCP）。 # 高级：适用于大型服务器微调，风险自负。 properties: connectionTimeout: 60000 idleTimeout: 10000 maxLifetime: 1800000 maximumPoolSize: 10 minimumIdle: 10 cachePrepStmts: true prepStmtCacheSize: 250 prepStmtCacheSqlLimit: 2048 useUnicode: true characterEncoding: utf8 allowPublicKeyRetrieval: true keepaliveTime: 60000

若要将 QuickShop 数据从一个数据库类型迁移到另一个数据库，将数据导出并导入新数据库。 只需在控制台执行 /quickshop export 命令即可。 QuickShop 将创建包含商店数据的 ZIP 压缩包。 关闭服务器，切换使用存储类型，重启服务器。 商店一开始会因为数据源为空而显示为失效；只需从导出文件中导入数据即可恢复。 将导出的 ZIP 压缩包重命名为 recovery.zip，输入 /quickshop recovery 命令后重启服务器即可。 现在所有商店都会恢复，并能正常使用。
QuickShop 使用经济格式将余额格式化为可读文本。
默认情况下，QuickShop 会请求经济插件来格式化经济数据，但有些时候可能会失效（例如经济插件代码中返回了 null），那么 QuickShop 将会返回至内部经济格式，确保经济数据可被格式化。

内部格式化器仅在经济插件格式化器不可用时使用。 可以通过在 config.yml 中修饰相关的设置，强制 QuickShop 使用它： # 格式化经济的值是否使用小数。 use-decimal-format: false # 小数格式。 # 默认：#,###.## decimal-format: '#,###.##' shop: # 若 Vault/经济插件没有提供，则使用此处默认。 alternate-currency-symbol: $ # 若 Vault 格式不正确，强制 QuickShop 使用代替经济符号。 disable-vault-format: false # 在右侧显示货币符号（例如：1234$）。 # 只在 disable-vault-format 为 true 时有效。 currency-symbol-on-right: false # 允许价格中出现的小数最大位数。 # 设置为 -1 表示不限制。 maximum-digits-in-price: -1

The Interaction Manager controls what QuickShop-Hikari does when a player clicks a shop sign, shop block, container, or shop display. This allows server owners to customize QuickShop interaction behavior for: standing players; sneaking players; left-clicks; right-clicks; shop signs; shop blocks; containers; display entities. Interaction behavior is configured in: interaction.yml

The current default configuration is: version: 4 # Chat Mode: STANDING_LEFT_CLICK_SIGN: TRADE_INTERACTION STANDING_RIGHT_CLICK_SIGN: CONTROL_PANEL STANDING_LEFT_CLICK_SHOPBLOCK: TRADE_INTERACTION STANDING_RIGHT_CLICK_SHOPBLOCK: NONE # Reserve for open chest STANDING_LEFT_CLICK_CONTAINER: TRADE_INTERACTION STANDING_RIGHT_CLICK_CONTAINER: NONE STANDING_LEFT_CLICK_DISPLAY: NONE STANDING_RIGHT_CLICK_DISPLAY: NONE SNEAKING_LEFT_CLICK_CONTAINER: NONE SNEAKING_RIGHT_CLICK_CONTAINER: NONE SNEAKING_LEFT_CLICK_DISPLAY: NONE SNEAKING_RIGHT_CLICK_DISPLAY: NONE SNEAKING_LEFT_CLICK_SIGN: NONE SNEAKING_RIGHT_CLICK_SIGN: NONE SNEAKING_LEFT_CLICK_SHOPBLOCK: NONE SNEAKING_RIGHT_CLICK_SHOPBLOCK: NONE # Reserve for open chest The key defines how the player interacted with the shop. The value defines which QuickShop behavior should run.
QuickShop supports several interaction targets.
SIGN The shop information sign associated with the shop. Examples: STANDING_LEFT_CLICK_SIGN STANDING_RIGHT_CLICK_SIGN

SHOPBLOCK The block representing the shop itself. For a normal container shop, this is typically the shop's chest or other supported inventory block. Examples: STANDING_LEFT_CLICK_SHOPBLOCK SNEAKING_RIGHT_CLICK_SHOPBLOCK

CONTAINER A direct interaction with the shop's inventory container. Examples: STANDING_LEFT_CLICK_CONTAINER STANDING_RIGHT_CLICK_CONTAINER SNEAKING_LEFT_CLICK_CONTAINER SNEAKING_RIGHT_CLICK_CONTAINER The default configuration reserves normal right-click container behavior by assigning: STANDING_RIGHT_CLICK_CONTAINER: NONE

DISPLAY Interactions with QuickShop's shop display. The available display interaction keys are: STANDING_LEFT_CLICK_DISPLAY: NONE STANDING_RIGHT_CLICK_DISPLAY: NONE SNEAKING_LEFT_CLICK_DISPLAY: NONE SNEAKING_RIGHT_CLICK_DISPLAY: NONE By default, all four display interactions use: NONE so interacting directly with a display does not trigger a QuickShop behavior unless the server owner explicitly configures one. info Display interaction keys are separate from sign, shop-block, and container interactions. This allows display entities to have their own behavior without changing how the physical shop block works.
Each interaction distinguishes between a player who is standing normally and a player who is sneaking.
Keys beginning with: STANDING_ apply when the player is not sneaking. For example: STANDING_LEFT_CLICK_SIGN

Keys beginning with: SNEAKING_ apply while the player is sneaking. For example: SNEAKING_LEFT_CLICK_SIGN This makes it possible to assign different actions to the same click depending on whether the player is holding the sneak key.
LEFT_CLICK Represents Minecraft's normal attack/break interaction. For example: STANDING_LEFT_CLICK_SIGN

RIGHT_CLICK Represents Minecraft's normal use/interact action. For example: STANDING_RIGHT_CLICK_SIGN Some right-click interactions default to NONE so Minecraft's normal block or inventory behavior can continue.

The current built-in interaction keys include: Key Description STANDING_LEFT_CLICK_SIGN Left-click a shop sign while standing STANDING_RIGHT_CLICK_SIGN Right-click a shop sign while standing STANDING_LEFT_CLICK_SHOPBLOCK Left-click a shop block while standing STANDING_RIGHT_CLICK_SHOPBLOCK Right-click a shop block while standing STANDING_LEFT_CLICK_CONTAINER Left-click the shop container while standing STANDING_RIGHT_CLICK_CONTAINER Right-click the shop container while standing STANDING_LEFT_CLICK_DISPLAY Left-click the shop display while standing STANDING_RIGHT_CLICK_DISPLAY Right-click the shop display while standing SNEAKING_LEFT_CLICK_SIGN Left-click a shop sign while sneaking SNEAKING_RIGHT_CLICK_SIGN Right-click a shop sign while sneaking SNEAKING_LEFT_CLICK_SHOPBLOCK Left-click a shop block while sneaking SNEAKING_RIGHT_CLICK_SHOPBLOCK Right-click a shop block while sneaking SNEAKING_LEFT_CLICK_CONTAINER Left-click the shop container while sneaking SNEAKING_RIGHT_CLICK_CONTAINER Right-click the shop container while sneaking SNEAKING_LEFT_CLICK_DISPLAY Left-click the shop display while sneaking SNEAKING_RIGHT_CLICK_DISPLAY Right-click the shop display while sneaking

QuickShop currently provides several built-in interaction behaviors. Behavior Description TRADE_UI Opens the GUI-based Trade Menu TRADE_INTERACTION Uses the chat-based trading interaction TRADE_DIRECT Immediately performs a single direct trade TRADE_DIRECT_ALL Immediately trades the available amount CONTROL_PANEL_UI Opens the GUI-based shop control panel CONTROL_PANEL Uses the chat-based shop control panel NONE Performs no QuickShop interaction behavior

The default configuration uses the traditional interaction behavior: STANDING_LEFT_CLICK_SIGN: TRADE_INTERACTION STANDING_RIGHT_CLICK_SIGN: CONTROL_PANEL STANDING_LEFT_CLICK_SHOPBLOCK: TRADE_INTERACTION STANDING_RIGHT_CLICK_SHOPBLOCK: NONE STANDING_LEFT_CLICK_CONTAINER: TRADE_INTERACTION STANDING_RIGHT_CLICK_CONTAINER: NONE STANDING_LEFT_CLICK_DISPLAY: NONE STANDING_RIGHT_CLICK_DISPLAY: NONE SNEAKING_LEFT_CLICK_CONTAINER: NONE SNEAKING_RIGHT_CLICK_CONTAINER: NONE SNEAKING_LEFT_CLICK_DISPLAY: NONE SNEAKING_RIGHT_CLICK_DISPLAY: NONE SNEAKING_LEFT_CLICK_SIGN: NONE SNEAKING_RIGHT_CLICK_SIGN: NONE SNEAKING_LEFT_CLICK_SHOPBLOCK: NONE SNEAKING_RIGHT_CLICK_SHOPBLOCK: NONE This keeps normal shop trading and management on the shop's physical sign/block while leaving display interactions disabled by default.

To use QuickShop's GUI-based trading and control panel, interactions can instead be mapped to: TRADE_UI CONTROL_PANEL_UI For example: STANDING_LEFT_CLICK_SIGN: TRADE_UI STANDING_RIGHT_CLICK_SIGN: CONTROL_PANEL_UI STANDING_LEFT_CLICK_SHOPBLOCK: TRADE_UI STANDING_RIGHT_CLICK_SHOPBLOCK: NONE SNEAKING_LEFT_CLICK_SIGN: TRADE_UI SNEAKING_RIGHT_CLICK_SIGN: CONTROL_PANEL_UI SNEAKING_LEFT_CLICK_SHOPBLOCK: TRADE_UI SNEAKING_RIGHT_CLICK_SHOPBLOCK: NONE The display keys can also be configured independently if you want interactions with the shop display to open a GUI. For example: STANDING_LEFT_CLICK_DISPLAY: TRADE_UI STANDING_RIGHT_CLICK_DISPLAY: CONTROL_PANEL_UI

QuickShop also supports direct trade behaviors. An example configuration is: STANDING_LEFT_CLICK_SIGN: TRADE_INTERACTION STANDING_RIGHT_CLICK_SIGN: CONTROL_PANEL STANDING_LEFT_CLICK_SHOPBLOCK: TRADE_INTERACTION STANDING_RIGHT_CLICK_SHOPBLOCK: NONE SNEAKING_LEFT_CLICK_SIGN: TRADE_DIRECT SNEAKING_RIGHT_CLICK_SIGN: TRADE_DIRECT_ALL SNEAKING_LEFT_CLICK_SHOPBLOCK: TRADE_DIRECT SNEAKING_RIGHT_CLICK_SHOPBLOCK: NONE This allows normal interaction while standing and faster direct trading while sneaking.

The four display interactions are disabled by default: STANDING_LEFT_CLICK_DISPLAY: NONE STANDING_RIGHT_CLICK_DISPLAY: NONE SNEAKING_LEFT_CLICK_DISPLAY: NONE SNEAKING_RIGHT_CLICK_DISPLAY: NONE You can assign them the same behaviors used by signs and shop blocks. For example, to make a normal left-click on the display open the Trade Menu: STANDING_LEFT_CLICK_DISPLAY: TRADE_UI To make right-click open the shop control panel: STANDING_RIGHT_CLICK_DISPLAY: CONTROL_PANEL_UI Or configure sneaking interactions separately: SNEAKING_LEFT_CLICK_DISPLAY: TRADE_DIRECT SNEAKING_RIGHT_CLICK_DISPLAY: TRADE_DIRECT_ALL This makes the shop display a fully configurable interaction target rather than forcing it to behave like the underlying shop block.

The behavior: NONE tells QuickShop not to execute an interaction behavior for that input. This is commonly used where Minecraft's normal interaction should remain available. For example: STANDING_RIGHT_CLICK_SHOPBLOCK: NONE allows normal right-click behavior on the shop block rather than forcing QuickShop to open another interaction. The same default applies to display interactions: STANDING_LEFT_CLICK_DISPLAY: NONE STANDING_RIGHT_CLICK_DISPLAY: NONE SNEAKING_LEFT_CLICK_DISPLAY: NONE SNEAKING_RIGHT_CLICK_DISPLAY: NONE

A server could configure interactions so that: standing left-click opens the Trade GUI; standing right-click opens the Control Panel; sneaking left-click performs a direct trade; display left-click opens the Trade GUI; display right-click does nothing. For example: version: 4 STANDING_LEFT_CLICK_SIGN: TRADE_UI STANDING_RIGHT_CLICK_SIGN: CONTROL_PANEL_UI STANDING_LEFT_CLICK_SHOPBLOCK: TRADE_UI STANDING_RIGHT_CLICK_SHOPBLOCK: NONE STANDING_LEFT_CLICK_CONTAINER: TRADE_UI STANDING_RIGHT_CLICK_CONTAINER: NONE STANDING_LEFT_CLICK_DISPLAY: TRADE_UI STANDING_RIGHT_CLICK_DISPLAY: NONE SNEAKING_LEFT_CLICK_SIGN: TRADE_DIRECT SNEAKING_RIGHT_CLICK_SIGN: TRADE_DIRECT_ALL SNEAKING_LEFT_CLICK_SHOPBLOCK: TRADE_DIRECT SNEAKING_RIGHT_CLICK_SHOPBLOCK: NONE SNEAKING_LEFT_CLICK_CONTAINER: NONE SNEAKING_RIGHT_CLICK_CONTAINER: NONE SNEAKING_LEFT_CLICK_DISPLAY: TRADE_DIRECT SNEAKING_RIGHT_CLICK_DISPLAY: NONE

The Interaction Manager lets you independently control: Player posture + Click type + Interaction target + QuickShop behavior In the current interaction configuration, QuickShop supports signs, shop blocks, containers, and displays as separate targets. The new display interaction mappings are: STANDING_LEFT_CLICK_DISPLAY: NONE STANDING_RIGHT_CLICK_DISPLAY: NONE SNEAKING_LEFT_CLICK_DISPLAY: NONE SNEAKING_RIGHT_CLICK_DISPLAY: NONE These default to NONE, but server owners can map them to any registered QuickShop interaction behavior.
Hikari允许您使用字符串来表示或匹配物品。
直接输入 Bukkit 材料名即可。 - BEDROCK # 选择匹配给定材料名的物品 - GOLDEN_SWORD 可以在这里找到所有材料名称。
在物品引用名称前添加 @ 前缀。 - "@purediamond" # 选择匹配特定物品引用的物品 您可参考 物品引用系统
在附魔命名键前添加 % 前缀。 - "%minecraft:sharpness" # 选择所有携带“锋利”附魔的物品 - "%minecraft:sharpness|1|3" # 选择所有携带“锋利 I”至“锋利 III”附魔的物品 - "%ecoenchants:soulbound" # 也支持第三方插件添加的附魔，但必须以 Bukkit 的方式进行注册
在某些情况下，只用材料名称是不够的。

想象一下，这样很容易限制石头的价格： rules: # 规则集 cheap-stone: # 规则名称，用于在 ID 与权限中表示（quickshop.price.restriction.bypass.<name>） items: # 规则下的物品（https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/spigot/org/bukkit/Material.html），或在名称前加上 @ 表示引用物品查找表 - STONE currency: # 货币名称，若插件不支持多经济（Vualt API），则不需要使用此部分配置 - '*' min: 0.01 # 最小价格（双精度浮点数） max: 1.00 # 最大价格（双精度浮点数） 如果我需要限制的是粘液科技的自定义物品呢？

手持你需要新建引用的物品，输入命令 /quickshop lookup create <name>。 你还可以在物品名称前加上 @ 表示使用引用。 rules: # 规则集 cheap-stone: # 规则名称，用于在 ID 与权限中表示（quickshop.price.restriction.bypass.<name>） items: # 规则下的物品（https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/spigot/org/bukkit/Material.html），或在名称前加上 @ 表示引用物品查找表 - "@purediamond" currency: # 货币名称，若插件不支持多经济（Vualt API），则不需要使用此部分配置 - '*' min: 0.01 # 最小价格（双精度浮点数） max: 1.00 # 最大价格（双精度浮点数） 这个规则可以只限制高纯钻石的价格！

The Item Matcher controls how QuickShop-Hikari decides whether two ItemStacks should be treated as the same item for shop matching. Because item matching affects trading, stock checks, item lookup, and shop behavior, changing these settings can have significant consequences. caution Incorrect matcher configuration can cause unexpected shop behavior and may create item-matching inconsistencies. Keep the defaults unless you specifically need different comparison behavior.

QuickShop-Hikari currently supports four matcher modes: work-type Matcher Status 0 QuickShop 物品匹配 Deprecated; planned for removal in 6.4 1 Bukkit Item Matcher Default 2 严格 Bukkit 物品匹配 Supported 3 现代匹配 Supported; configurable with Data Components Configure the matcher in config.yml: matcher: # Matcher type: # 0 = QuickShop matcher (deprecated; planned for removal in 6.4) # 1 = Bukkit matcher # 2 = Strict Bukkit matcher (equals method) # 3 = Modern matcher work-type: 1

The default matcher is: work-type: 1 This uses Bukkit's item similarity behavior and is the recommended default for most servers. It provides good compatibility with normal Bukkit/Paper item handling without requiring additional matcher configuration.
The strict Bukkit matcher is: work-type: 2 This uses a stricter equality comparison than the normal Bukkit matcher. Use this only if you specifically need stricter item equality rules.

The Modern Matcher is: work-type: 3 The Modern Matcher was introduced for modern Paper versions and uses Paper's Data Component API. It is whitelist-based: only enabled component keys under: matcher.components are compared. This makes it the preferred configurable matcher for newer QuickShop installations.

The Modern Matcher also supports these base settings: matcher: # Ignore stack amount while matching. # Recommended for shop matching. ignore-count: true # Require ItemStack#getType() to match. # Strongly recommended. check-material: true

ignore-count: true When enabled, the amount of items in the stack does not affect whether two items match. For example: 1 diamond 64 diamonds can still represent the same shop item. This is the recommended behavior for shop matching.
check-material: true Requires both items to have the same Bukkit material. For example: DIAMOND will not match: EMERALD This should normally remain enabled.

The Modern Matcher compares only the enabled entries under: matcher: components: There are two kinds of entries: Direct component keys — map directly to Paper Data Component keys. Group component toggles — expand into multiple related component keys.

The current built-in direct component configuration is: matcher: components: DAMAGE: true REPAIR_COST: false CUSTOM_NAME: true ITEM_NAME: false LORE: true CUSTOM_MODEL_DATA: true ENCHANTMENTS: true STORED_ENCHANTMENTS: true ATTRIBUTE_MODIFIERS: true UNBREAKABLE: true TRIM: true DYED_COLOR: true HIDE_ADDITIONAL_TOOLTIP: true ENCHANTMENT_GLINT_OVERRIDE: true POTION_CONTENTS: true POTION_DURATION_SCALE: true These correspond to modern item components such as durability, lore, enchantments, custom names, trim, potion data, and other item metadata.

The current grouped component toggles are: matcher: components: BOOKS: true BANNER: true SKULL: true FIREWORK: true MAP: true LEATHER_ARMOR: true FISH_BUCKET: true SUSPICIOUS_STEW: true SHULKER_BOX: true BUNDLE: true Group toggles represent logical groups of related Data Components. For example: BOOKS covers the relevant written and writable book components rather than requiring each underlying component key to be configured individually.

A complete current configuration looks like: matcher: # 0 = QuickShop matcher (deprecated; planned for removal in 6.4) # 1 = Bukkit matcher # 2 = Strict Bukkit matcher # 3 = Modern matcher work-type: 3 # Ignore stack size when matching. ignore-count: true # Require the material/type to match. check-material: true components: # Direct component keys DAMAGE: true REPAIR_COST: false CUSTOM_NAME: true ITEM_NAME: false LORE: true CUSTOM_MODEL_DATA: true ENCHANTMENTS: true STORED_ENCHANTMENTS: true ATTRIBUTE_MODIFIERS: true UNBREAKABLE: true TRIM: true DYED_COLOR: true HIDE_ADDITIONAL_TOOLTIP: true ENCHANTMENT_GLINT_OVERRIDE: true POTION_CONTENTS: true POTION_DURATION_SCALE: true # Group component toggles BOOKS: true BANNER: true SKULL: true FIREWORK: true MAP: true LEATHER_ARMOR: true FISH_BUCKET: true SUSPICIOUS_STEW: true SHULKER_BOX: true BUNDLE: true

The legacy QuickShop Item Matcher is: work-type: 0 warning The QuickShop Item Matcher is deprecated and planned for removal in QuickShop-Hikari 6.4. Existing servers may continue using it during the 6.3 series, but new configurations should use the Bukkit matcher or Modern Matcher instead. The legacy matcher uses the older: matcher: item: configuration model. Example: matcher: item: damage: true repaircost: false displayname: true lores: true enchs: true potions: true attributes: true itemflags: true custommodeldata: true books: true banner: true skull: true firework: true map: true leatherArmor: true fishBucket: true suspiciousStew: true shulkerBox: true bundle: true These settings affect only the legacy QuickShop matcher. They do not control the Modern Matcher.

The old matcher.item settings control comparisons for metadata such as: Setting Purpose damage Item durability/damage repaircost Anvil repair cost displayname Custom display name lores Item lore enchs Enchantments and stored enchantments potions Potion data attributes Attribute modifiers itemflags Bukkit item flags custommodeldata CustomModelData books Book metadata banner Banner metadata skull Skull/player-head metadata firework Firework metadata map Map metadata leatherArmor Leather armor metadata fishBucket Tropical fish bucket metadata suspiciousStew Suspicious stew effects shulkerBox Shulker box contents bundle Bundle contents Because this matcher is deprecated, avoid building new server behavior around these settings.
The two configurable matcher systems use different configuration sections.
work-type: 0 matcher: item: damage: true lores: true enchs: true

work-type: 3 matcher: ignore-count: true check-material: true components: DAMAGE: true LORE: true ENCHANTMENTS: true Do not mix the two models. The matcher.item section belongs to the deprecated QuickShop matcher. The matcher.components section belongs to the Modern Matcher.

For most servers: work-type: 1 is the safest default. Use: work-type: 2 only when strict Bukkit equality is specifically desired. Use: work-type: 3 when you need configurable modern Data Component matching. Avoid selecting: work-type: 0 for new installations because the legacy QuickShop matcher is planned for removal in 6.4.

QuickShop-Hikari currently provides: 0 = QuickShop Item Matcher 1 = Bukkit Item Matcher 2 = Strict Bukkit Matcher 3 = Modern Matcher The important distinction is: matcher.item → Legacy QuickShop Matcher matcher.components → Modern Matcher The legacy matcher remains available during 6.3 for compatibility, but it is deprecated and planned for removal in 6.4.
ItemStack加载器是加载Bukkit ItemStack的工具。 caution 在使用此功能之前，请务必创建一个完整的服务器备份。 启用后，更改将永久地写入世界和数据库；没有备份就无法回滚。

当您更新到 Minecraft 到较新版本并在之后降级（但没有同时回滚 quickshop 数据库）时，您可能会看到如下错误： [Server] ERROR Could not call method 'public static org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack.deserialize(java.util.Map)' of class org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack for deserialization [Server] INFO java.lang.IllegalArgumentException: Newer version! Server downgrades are not supported! 在这种情况下，我们的建议是恢复最后一个正常的QuickShop数据库备份，但是如果您不幸丢失了所有备份，则可以尝试以下解决方法。 QuickShop 会在控制台出现因版本降级而出现错误时提示, 例如: [QuickShop-Hikari] [WARN] Cannot load ItemStack {ITEM_INFO} because it was saved by a newer Minecraft server version. The action will fail and you will receive an exception. PLEASE DON'T REPORT THIS TO QUICKSHOP! [QuickShop-Hikari] [WARN] You can try force load this ItemStack by our hacked ItemStack read util(shop.force-load-downgrade-items), but beware, the data may damaged if you load on this lower Minecraft server version, Please backup your world and database before enable!

更改 config.yml 中的以下设置，可以使加载器正常运行： shop: # 跨版本物品载入（高级/风险自负） # 尝试载入高版本 Minecraft 创建的物品。 # 警告：这可能导致服务器或商店数据损坏，请先备份。 force-load-downgrade-items: enable: true # 工作模式： # 0 = 让 Bukkit 更新 ItemStack # 1 = 让 Bukkit 直接载入 ItemStack method: 0 方法 0 会让 Bukkit 更新 ItemStack 版本，而方法 1 则会让 Bukkit 直接载入它。 默认情况下，此值为 0。
QuickShop-Hikari 跟随玩家选择的客户端语言。 所有翻译都是由志愿者在 Crowdin 上提供的。
若要帮助翻译 QuickShop-Hikari，请访问我们的 Crowdin 主页。
QuickShop-Hikari 会自动通过 Crowdin OTA 更新翻译。 重新加载 QuickShop-Hikari 或重新启动服务器时，对本地翻译文件的任何直接更改都会被覆盖。 这可以让翻译保持最新，无需手动干预。
重启或重载后会导致本地改动丢失，因此请勿编辑原文件。 请使用翻译覆盖系统。
在使用覆盖系统之前，您必须从 Github 获取原始翻译文件（因为本地覆盖文件默认为空）。 点击此处 找到你需要的语言，打开并下载翻译文件。
documents.s: 从 Github 获取原始文件

documents.t: 跳转到您的语言对应的 OTA 覆盖文件夹： MINECRAFT_SERVER_ROOT/plugins/QuickShop-Hikari/override/LOCALE_CODE/messages.yml 你应该会找到一个空白的 YAML 文件。 将其打开。 从原文复制需要修改的键名与键值，放入覆盖文件，然后编辑必要的内容。 你可以完全复制整个文件夹的内容，或者保持文件结构，复制后再将其修改。 未被覆盖设置的翻译键会使用来自 Crowdin OTA 的设置。 翻译支持 MiniMessage 语法。 你可能需要用到 MiniMessage 网页浏览器
保存文件，然后运行 /quickshop reload 命令即可。
覆盖文件不会自动更新。 上游翻译更新时，你需要手动更改。
在游戏内输入 /quickshop debug 开启调试模式。 重新加入服务器或改变客户端使用的语言；控制台即会显示使用的语言代码。

documents.t: 如果您的服务器不面向世界各地的玩家，或者如果您想禁用服务器上的特定语言，则可以在 config.yml 中进行设置。 # 特定玩家语言设置。 # 若玩家使用了禁用的语言，则插件会使用“默认语言”。 # # 用法： # - '*' 表示启用所有可用的语言。 # # 语言可通过 Crowdin OTA 自动更新： # https://crowdin.com/project/qs-hikari # # 自定义翻译请使用语言覆盖系统： # https://quickshop-community.github.io/QuickShop-Hikari-Documents/docs/modules/localization enabled-languages: - '*' 例如，要在服务器上仅允许 zh-CN 语言，您可以设置为： enabled-languages: - 'zh-CN' 或者多种语言 enabled-languages: - 'zh-CN' - 'zh-HK' - 'zh-TW'

在某些情况下，QuickShop-Hikari需要使用全局默认语言，您可以使用此选项修改默认全局语言。 尽管在绝大多数情况下，QuickShop-Hikari不会使用此选项， 您仍然可以配置它(如果您想要)，我们建议保留默认值。 config.yml 中的注释可能已过时。 # 插件使用的默认语言。 # 设置为“default”表示自动跟随玩家使用的客户端语言。 # 示例语言代码：en_us game-language: default
如果您所在的区域无法访问我们的 OTA 服务器，或者您的连接非常缓慢。 您可以直接禁用 CrowdinOTA，QuickShop-Hikari 仍将使用缓存的翻译或捆绑翻译。 若需禁用 CrowdinOTA，只需在启动标志中加上： -Dcom.ghostchu.quickshop.localization.text.SimpleTextManager.enableCrowdinOTA=false
从 6.3.0.0 SNAPSHOT 2 开始，JVM 启动参数已移动到 config.yml 中`。 使用 use-crowdin-ota: false
如果你使用 CrowdinCopyDeploy 自行托管翻译服务器，你可以将 OTA 客户端指向自有的服务器。 -Dcom.ghostchu.quickshop.localization.text.SimpleTextManager=<YOUR_SERVER_ADDRESS>

QuickShop-Hikari支持一些多货币经济插件或桥接插件，但它们不是开箱即用的，您必须配置它们才能生效。
QuickShop-Hikari 目前支持使用了 VaultUnlocked 的多经济插件
只需用 VaultUnlocked 代替原本的 Vault，即可启用多币种支持 # 经济提供方选择。 # 0 = Vault/VaultUnlocked # VaultUnlocked 支持多币种插件。 # # 高级选项—请在更改之前寻求必要帮助。 economy-type: 0
您需要为默认使用设置一种货币（例如新商店默认货币），并在 config.yml 中进行配置： # 创建商店时使用的货币。 # 设置为 "" 使用默认货币。 # 只在安装多货币插件时需要设置。 currency: ''
您可以为符号设置备用符号，QuickShop-Hikari 将在文本中对特定货币的符号替换为备用符号。 # 多货币符号映射： # 格式：<currencyName>;<symbol> # 如果没有匹配，则使用货币名称本身。 alternate-currency-symbol-list: - USD;$ - CNY;￥
看向商店，输入 /quickshop currency <new-currency> 即可修改商店使用的货币。
维护费用始终收取服务器层面的默认货币（currency）。
收税时将使用商店的对应货币，使用全局税率计算（尚无法修改）。 若需要此功能，请在我们的漏洞追踪器上提交功能请求！
大多数QuickShop-Hikari网络请求不使用系统代理。
用户代理是不可更改的，它强制硬代码为： QuickShop/<fork-name>-<version> Java/<java-version> 它看起来像这样： QuickShop/Hikari-3.4.0.2 Java/17.0.3
在大多数情况下，您不需要这么做，但在一些国家，您可能无法访问我们的云服务，如CrowdinOTA或Paste。 要配置 http 代理，您需要在您的 JVM 启动命令行中添加参数。 java -Xmx4G ... <JVM FLAG> ... -jar server.jar nogui
-Dcom.ghostchu.quickshop.QuickShopBukkit.proxyHost=<host> -Dcom.ghostchu.quickshop.QuickShopBukkit.proxyPort=<port>

-Dcom.ghostchu.quickshop.QuickShopBukkit.proxyHost=<host> -Dcom.ghostchu.quickshop.QuickShopBukkit.proxyPort=<port> -Dcom.ghostchu.quickshop.QuickShopBukkit.proxyUsername=<user> -Dcom.ghostchu.quickshop.QuickShopBukkit.proxyPassword=<password>
要强制忽略 SSL 错误，您可以添加此启动标志来禁用 SSL 验证。 -Dcom.ghostchu.quickshop.QuickShopBukkit.verifySSL=false
如果您运行的是大型服务器网络，则可以调整 QuickShop-Hikari 设置以获得更好的性能。 info QuickShop-Hikari 的默认配置注重性能和玩家体验平衡。 无需调整，除非插件影响了服务器性能。
随着 QuickShop-Hikari 的操作，一些记录可能会被隔离，不再被其他数据引用。 修剪孤立的数据可以改善插件启动时间和数据库查询时间。 /quickshop database trim
caution 清除历史日志还将重置此服务器上的所有QuickShop-Hikari统计，并有可能使依赖内部统计的其他插件停止工作。 谨慎操作，注意备份！ QuickShop-Hikari会将日志记录到数据库中，包括： 系统日志 商店创建 商店更改 商店删除 玩家购买 QuickShop-Hikari的任何交易 你可以输入如下命令清理： /quickshop database purgelogs
note 默认情况下，此功能 已启用 ，但仅在安装了 ProtocolLib 或 PacketEvents 时才有效。 如果你还没试过虚拟展示物品，现在就试试看吧！ 它能极大提升悬浮物的性能和服务器的刻时间计算。 请参阅 悬浮物系统

note 默认情况下，此功能 禁用 。 离线玩家名补全可以优化使用体验。 若使用离线模式，这会创建大量的 Mojang API 访问请求。 这会增加 Mojang API 服务器的负载，可能会在过多请求后临时封禁你的的 IP 几分钟。 更改 config.yml 中的以下设置，可以禁用这个功能： # 是否允许 QS 使用离线玩家列表填入 tab 补全列表？ # 可以提升玩家使用体验，但也可能在请求数量过大时导致服务器卡顿。 # false = 只使用在线玩家列表。 # true = 列出所有加入过服务器的玩家列表。 include-offlineplayer-list: false
documents.s: 关闭离线玩家自动补全功能
documents.h: #关闭离线玩家自动补全功能

documents.t: note 默认情况下，此功能 禁用 。 QuickShop-Hikari会在漏斗等物品传输事件上，重新计算商店库存内容。 它可能会在繁忙或生电服务器上造成相当高的负载，并降低服务器 TPS。 可以通过更改下面的设置禁用它： shop: # 当某些内容（例如漏斗）触发 InventoryMoveItemEvent 改变容器内容时是否更新告示牌？ # 若影响了服务器性能，请将其禁用。 update-sign-when-inventory-moving: false

documents.h: #关闭响应式剩余库存剩余空间重计算

documents.t: note 默认情况下，此功能 禁用 。 展示物自动删除功能会检查附近所有载入的商店位置，计算同一世界所有在线玩家与其的距离。 这可能会对服务器造成严重负担。 通过更改下面的设置禁用此功能： shop: # 允许 QuickShop 在商店范围内没有玩家时自动禁用物品展示。 display-auto-despawn: false

documents.t: note 默认情况下，此功能 禁用 。 如果您的服务器没有从 QuickShop-Reemake 迁移，您应该关闭此选项，以避免不必要的告示牌元数据检查。 # 旧数据更新器 # 打开后会让 QuickShop 执行额外检查并可能影响性能。 # 若你是从旧版本更新，则建议将其开启。 legacy-updater: shop-sign: false

QuickShop 支持您将商店设置为“系统商店”，从而创建一个无限制库存（出售）或无限容量（收购）的商店。
尽管您将一个商店设置为“系统商店”，商店的店主也仍然是您！
看向本插件的商店并输入命令 /quickshop unlimited 即可将其在有限与无限模式间切换。 无限商店 普通商店（缺货）

documents.t: 你可以在 config.yml 中启用 unlimited-shop-owner-change，并在 unlimited-shop-owner-change-account 处填入转让的玩家名称或 UUID。 启用后，将商店切换为“无限”模式就会将其转让给指定的玩家。 只对新转化的无限商店有效。 现存的无限商店不会自动改变，你必须再次将其切换才可应用更改。 此种情况下转移的商店，不受到玩家商店数量上限的限制。

documents.t: 商店分成功能允许你将商店赚取的资金以不同的比例分配给多个玩家。

看向本插件的商店，输入命令 /quickshop benefit add <player><percentage>（示例：/quickshop benefit add Aether 50%）将会将<percentage>%的盈利分给玩家<player。 例子： /quickshop benefit add Nahida 50% /quickshop benefit add Venti 30% 通过这些命令，店主的收入中有 50% 将会被分成给玩家 Nahida，30% 被分成给玩家 Venti。 当商店赚钱时 100$，Nahida会得到 50$ 获得奖励，Venti 将获得 30$ 获得奖励，店主将获得剩余物 20% (20$） 作为奖励。.
若要使得玩家不再参与分红，只需输入命令： /quickshop benefit remove <player>。
若要查询商店内的所有分红，只需输入命令：/quickshop benefit query。

documents.t: 取决于不同经济插件的支持情况，分成可能导致一些精度的丢失。 当金额太小，部分经济插件可能会进行四舍五入，有时也可能出现小数点精度丢失的情况如 2.899999999999999 这样的数字。 QuickShop-Hikari 针对这种问题进行了一些修复。 如果还是有这样的问题，请不要汇报；这是预期行为。
由于一些安全原因，QuickShop-Hikari 默认不允许将离线玩家添加到商店分成列表中。要解除此限制，您必须增加以下 JVM Startup Flag： -Dcom.ghostchu.quickshop.command.subcommand.SubCommand_Benefit.allowOffline=true
从 6.3.0.0 SNAPSHOT 2 开始，JVM 启动参数已移动到 config.yml 中 使用 shop.allow-offline-benefit: true
服务器管理员可以控制在哪里创建什么类型的商店。 可以根据以下信息限制创建商店： 世界黑名单 世界白名单 物品黑名单 物品描述黑名单 这些规则只影响新创建的商店，不会影响现有商店。
QuickShop 现在支持黑名单和白名单模式，方便控制指定世界的商店创建。
shop.blacklist-world 中的世界不能创建商店。 shop: # 禁用新建商店功能的世界。 blacklist-world: - disabled_world_name 如果某个世界出现在这个列表中： 玩家不能在这里新建商店。 现存的商店仍然可以正常交互。 可以继续与商店交易，除非在别处额外配置。
世界白名单功能让玩家只能在特定世界里新建商店。 shop: # 只能在这些世界里新建商店。 whitelist-world: - survival_world - skyblock_world 使用 whitelist-world 设置时： 商店只能在这些世界里创建。 其他世界都会自动禁用创建商店功能。 其他世界已存在的商店仍然可以正常交互。
适用黑名单的情况： 你想要商店不能在指定的世界出现。 适用白名单的情况： 你只想要商店出现在某个世界里。 你的服务器有多个世界（创造、活动、小游戏等）。 你想要更加严格地管控经济。 推荐大型多世界服务器使用白名单模式。
你也可以限制哪些物品能上架。

在 config.yml 中，将物品添加进 blacklist 中： # 不能在商店中出售的物品。 # 拥有 quickshop.bypass.<itemID> 权限的玩家无视此限制。 # 若要引用物品查找表，请在名称前加上 @ 符号。 # 引用物品的绕过权限为 quickshop.bypass.reference。 blacklist: - Bedrock blacklist 支持： Bukkit 材料名 物品引用 标签（以 @ 开头） 通配符模式（6.2.0.11+） 示例通配符： blacklist: - "*_SPAWN_EGG" - "*_AXE"
通过关键词限制特定描述的物品上架： shop: # 包含指定关键词描述的物品禁止上架。 # 不会影响已存在的商店。 blacklist-lores: - "灵魂绑定" 如果物品包含符合条件的描述： 阻止创建商店。 现有的商店不受影响。
黑名单与白名单规则只会对如下过程生效： 新建商店 它们不会： 删除已有商店 禁用已有商店 若你需要删除现有商店，请试着： /qs clean /qs cleanghost 手动移除
对于多世界服务器： shop: whitelist-world: - survival - skyblock 对于创造服限制： shop: blacklist-world: - creative - minigames
黑名单系统可以： 控制哪些世界允许创建商店 限制特定的物品上架 通过描述禁用自定义物品上架 使用通配符模式 保护特殊用途世界 世界白名单支持（6.2.0.11+）允许更严格安全地控制大型服务器。
商店控制面板允许玩家安全方便地管理自己的商店。 通过控制面板，店主可以： 修改标价 更改数量 切换商店类型 冻结商店 切换无限模式 浏览历史记录 打开背包 转让所有权 删除商店 你可以通过配置文件自行决定控制面板显示的选项。
默认情况下，玩家可以通过这些方式打开： 潜行右键点击商店 通过配置好的交互行为 （若启用）使用控制面板菜单 控制面板可以是如下形式： 聊天栏 GUI 菜单界面（CONTROL_PANEL_UI）
documents.s: 玩家如何打开控制面板

documents.t: 控制面板选项配置在 config.yml 下面： shop: control-panel: 可以自行定义组件的显示与顺序。
如下为所有类型的内置控制面板组件。 每个条目都代表着面板中出现的按钮。
切换悬浮展示物品的开关。 决定了商店上方的悬浮物品是否可见。
修改商店价格 玩家可以直接更新交易价格。
修改商店出售一份物品的数量。 一般用于堆叠商店。
在这些商店类型之间切换： 出售 收购 冻结
打开商店绑定的容器界面。 适用于： 补货 浏览物品 管理库存
浏览商店交易历史。 （若历史记录功能启用）显示最近的购买与出售记录。
冻结或解冻商店。 冻结时： 禁用交易 商店仍然存在 可以稍后启用
切换无限模式。 启用后： 商店无需补货 可用于管理员商店
转让商店给其他玩家。 可能需要额外权限。
（对支持的商店）自动补货。 适用于自动化或管理环境。
删除商店。 永久移除： 商店本身 数据库条目 关联的元数据 请小心使用。
占位符组件。 可以用来在特定面板布局中创建空隙。
shop: control-panel: - DISPLAY - SET_PRICE - SET_AMOUNT - SHOP_MODE - INVENTORY - HISTORY - FREEZE - UNLIMITED - OWNER - REMOVE 你可以： 通过删除条目将其禁用 重新排列改变样式顺序
shop: control-panel: - SET_PRICE - SET_AMOUNT - SHOP_MODE - INVENTORY - HISTORY
shop: control-panel: - DISPLAY - SET_PRICE - SET_AMOUNT - SHOP_MODE - HISTORY - FREEZE
shop: control-panel: - DISPLAY - SET_PRICE - SHOP_MODE - UNLIMITED - OWNER - REMOVE
若你正在使用 GUI 菜单模式： 布局和图标都在 gui.yml 中配置 每个组件可以有自定义名称和描述 可以更改图标 可以调整顺序 控制面板配置控制显示的内容。 菜单设置文件则控制它的外观。
某些组件可能需要权限，取决于设置。 例如： 商店转让 无限商店 冻结 删除商店 检查权限配置确保控制面板上的功能可以正常使用。
删除组件将禁用所有玩家的组件。 REMOVE 组件会永久删除商店。 UNLIMITED 功能非常强大，只应提供给管理员使用。 FREEZE 适用于管理。 升级到 6.2.0.10 之后，请浏览这部分，确保你的控制面板与游戏玩法设计相适应。
商店控制面板可完全自定义。 通过编辑： shop: control-panel: 你可以控制： 哪些玩家可以修改 商店的功能涵盖范围 经济的行为 整体用户体验
商店控制面板玩家通过菜单界面而非聊天栏管理商店。 启用后，这个菜单可以代替传统的聊天栏。
控制面板菜单可通过交互管理器 CONTROL_PANEL_UI 打开： 当玩家与商店交互时： 如果 CONTROL_PANEL_UI 已启用 并且他们有权限 控制面板界面会自动打开 此行为由互动管理器内部处理。
控制面板提供直接管理商店的操作，例如： 设置价格 设置数量 修改商店模式（出售/收购/冻结） 冻结/解冻 切换无限模式 查看背包 查看历史 管理员工 转让商店 删除商店 可用的组件设置位于：config.yml → shop.control-panel
布局和图标都在 gui.yml 中配置 你可以修改： 标题 行 槽位 图标 名称 描述 按钮操作
如果名称或描述开头是 lang: 文本从 messages.yml 中读取 引用： 可以完全实现本地化。
上行： 价格/金额/模式 中行： 库存/历史/工作人员 下行： 冻结/无限/删除
店员允许店主添加或删除管理商店的玩家。 此功能可在控制面板的店长部分访问。
位于： 控制面板菜单 → 店长 → 店员管理 这可以打开玩家选择界面。
店员可以： 招募其他玩家作为店员 取消玩家的店员身份 不转让商店的前提下获得管理商店的权限 店员还可以： 修改标价 补货 切换模式 管理物品栏 浏览历史记录 权限取决于配置。
管理员工时： 玩家选择界面打开 可以搜索或选择玩家 点击切换其员工状态 方便大规模团队的商店管理。
布局和图标都在 gui.yml 中配置。 文本和按钮名称可以引用 lang: 下的条目；显示文本则从 messages.yml 中加载。
店员功能适用于如下场景： 城镇商店 国家商店 团队经济服务器 市场区域 工作人员监督的市场 它可以让授权不脱离控制。

QuickShop can display the item being bought or sold directly above a shop container. This makes shops easier to identify without requiring players to read the shop sign or open the shop interface. QuickShop-Hikari 6.3 introduces a new Display Entity system alongside the existing virtual item system.

Shop displays are controlled globally using the display-items option in config.yml: shop: display-items: true Set this to false to completely disable item displays for all shops. You can also control whether displays are enabled by default when shops are created: shop: display-default: true Setting display-default to false keeps the display system available while causing newly created shops to start with their display disabled.

The display implementation used by QuickShop is controlled with: shop: display-type: 3 QuickShop-Hikari 6.3 supports two display systems: Type Display System External Dependency 2 Virtual Item ProtocolLib or PacketEvents 3 Display Entity None

shop: display-type: 2 Display Type 2 creates a virtual item that is sent to players through packets. The displayed item exists on the player's client but does not exist as a normal item entity on the server. This mode requires either ProtocolLib or PacketEvents. Choose the packet implementation with: shop: display-protocol: protocollib Available values are: protocollib packetevents For example, to use PacketEvents: shop: display-type: 2 display-protocol: packetevents If the required packet library is unavailable, QuickShop cannot use the virtual display system.

shop: display-type: 3 Introduced in QuickShop-Hikari 6.3, Display Type 3 uses Minecraft's native Display Entity system. Unlike Display Type 2, this implementation does not depend on ProtocolLib or PacketEvents. Display Type 3 also provides additional display customization, including: Display scaling Display rotation Display positioning Optional display hitboxes Text Displays note The Text Display system has its own configuration and documentation because it provides significantly more customization than the item display itself. Text Displays currently only work when using: display-type: 3

For servers running a Minecraft version that supports Display Entities, display-type: 3 provides the most customization and does not require an external packet library. Use display-type: 2 if you specifically want QuickShop's packet-based virtual display implementation. A basic Display Entity configuration looks like: shop: display-items: true display-default: true display-type: 3
The position of the displayed item can be adjusted relative to the shop container: shop: display-coords: x: 0.5 y: 0.8 z: 0.5 Each value supports decimals.
Controls the east/west position of the display. x: 0.5 Positive values move the display east, while negative values move it west.
Controls the height of the display. y: 0.8 Positive values move the display upward, while negative values move it downward.

Controls the north/south position of the display. z: 0.5 Positive values move the display south, while negative values move it north. The default values position the display approximately above the center of the shop container.

info Display scaling only applies when using display-type: 3. The size of the displayed item can be customized independently along each axis: shop: display-scale: x: 1.25 y: 1.25 z: 1.25 The default scale is: 1.25 × 1.25 × 1.25 Using the same value for all three axes keeps the item proportionally scaled. For example, a smaller display could use: display-scale: x: 0.8 y: 0.8 z: 0.8 Changing individual axes can stretch or flatten the displayed item and is generally only useful for specialized layouts.

info Display rotation only applies when using display-type: 3. Display Entities can be rotated using an angle and rotation axis: shop: display-rotation: degrees: 0.0 x: 0.0 y: 1.0 z: 0.0 degrees controls the rotation angle. The x, y, and z values define the axis around which the item rotates. The default configuration: degrees: 0.0 x: 0.0 y: 1.0 z: 0.0 uses the vertical Y axis with no additional rotation. For example: display-rotation: degrees: 45.0 x: 0.0 y: 1.0 z: 0.0 rotates the display 45 degrees around the Y axis.

Display Entities can optionally have an interaction hitbox: shop: display-hitbox: false When disabled, the displayed item does not provide an additional interaction target. Enable this if you want players to be able to interact directly with the shop's displayed item. shop: display-hitbox: true How QuickShop responds to interactions with the display is controlled by the shop interaction configuration.
QuickShop can preserve enchantment visuals on displayed items: shop: display-allow-enchants: true Set this to false if you do not want displayed shop items to show their enchantment appearance.

QuickShop can allow display items to use stacked visual effects: shop: display-allow-stacks: false This setting is used when stack creation is enabled. note This option does not apply to Virtual Display Items (display-type: 2).

QuickShop can automatically remove displays when no players are near a shop. This can be useful for large shopping areas containing many shops. shop: display-auto-despawn: false display-despawn-range: 20 display-check-time: 40
Enables or disables automatic display despawning. display-auto-despawn: true
Controls the distance, in blocks, used to determine whether a display should remain active. display-despawn-range: 20

Controls how often QuickShop checks whether displays should be spawned or despawned. The value is measured in server ticks. display-check-time: 40 At the default Minecraft tick rate, 40 ticks is approximately two seconds. note display-check-time does not apply to Virtual Display Items (display-type: 2).

QuickShop can periodically validate the location of applicable display items: shop: display-items-check-ticks: 6000 Set the value to 0 to disable the validation check. display-items-check-ticks: 0 note This setting does not apply to Virtual Display Items (display-type: 2).

Shop displays can be enabled or disabled for individual shops. Look at the shop and run: /quickshop toggledisplay This allows players or administrators to hide displays for specific shops without disabling the display system globally. For example, this can be useful in dense shopping areas where many displays are visible at the same time. note If display-items is disabled globally in config.yml, enabling the display for an individual shop will not override the global setting.
documents.s: Toggling a Display for an Individual Shop

documents.t: The following configuration enables the 6.3 Display Entity system with the default positioning, rotation, and scale: shop: display-items: true display-default: true display-type: 3 display-auto-despawn: false display-despawn-range: 20 display-check-time: 40 display-allow-stacks: false display-allow-enchants: true display-hitbox: false display-coords: x: 0.5 y: 0.8 z: 0.5 display-rotation: degrees: 0.0 x: 0.0 y: 1.0 z: 0.0 display-scale: x: 1.25 y: 1.25 z: 1.25 This configuration uses Minecraft Display Entities and therefore does not require ProtocolLib or PacketEvents.

Older versions of QuickShop included additional real-item-based display implementations. These modes are no longer supported and should not be used on modern QuickShop-Hikari installations. Servers upgrading from an older QuickShop version should use either: display-type: 2 for Virtual Items, or: display-type: 3 for the modern Display Entity system.
QuickShop-Hikari 提供了一个系统，可用于单独控制每个商店的权限。 这不是插件权限节点，这是商店自己权限！ 要查看插件的权限节点，请单击 这里.
看向快捷商店，输入命令 /quickshop permission group list 即可列出商店中单独设置过的所有玩家。

QuickShop-Hikari有以下内置的商店权限组： quickshop-hikari.blocked - 所有属于此权限组的玩家都无法在此商店内交易 quickshop-hikari.everyone - 所有未定义的玩家都将拥有此组的权限。 quickshop-hikari.staff - 使用命令 /quickshop staff 会将命令执行者加入商店。 quickshop-hikari.admin - 与店主几乎完全相同的权限，几乎可以做任何事情。

QuickShop-Hikari 内置了如下权限： quickshop-hikari.purchase 任何拥有该权限的玩家可在该商店购买物品。 quickshop-hikari.show_information 任何拥有此权限的玩家均可打开商店的购买信息界面。 quickshop-hikari.preview_shop 任何拥有此权限的玩家会在购买界面出现一个 [预览物品] 按钮，并打开物品预览界面。 quickshop-hikari.search 任何拥有此权限的玩家都可以让该商店出现在 /quickshop find 的搜索结果中。 quickshop-hikari.delete 任何拥有该权限的玩家均可删除该商店。 quickshop-hikari.alert.receive 任何拥有该权限的玩家均会收到商店消息提醒。 quickshop-hikari.access_inventory 任何拥有该权限的玩家均可打开商店容器。 quickshop-hikari.ownership_transfer 任何拥有该权限的玩家均可转移商店所有权至其他玩家。 quickshop-hikari.management_permission 任何拥有该权限的玩家均可自行管理单商店权限分配。 quickshop-hikari.toggle_display 任何拥有该权限的玩家可通过命令 /quickshop toggledisplay 切换单商店展示物品。 quickshop-hikari.set_shoptype 任何拥有该权限的玩家均可使用命令 /quickshop buy 或 /quickshop sell 对商店的购买/出售状态进行切换。 quickshop-hikari.set_price 任何拥有该权限的玩家均可修改商店内的物品价格。 quickshop-hikari.set_item 任何拥有该权限的玩家均可修改商店内的出售/收购物品。 quickshop-hikari.set_stack_amount 任何拥有该权限的玩家均可修改商店内一份物品的量 （如价格为 5，份数设置为 5，则实际价格为 1 单位/个物品，且玩家只能以 5 的倍数购买物品）。 quickshop-hikari.set_currency 任何拥有该权限的玩家均可修改商店交易使用的货币。 quickshop-hikari.set_name 任何拥有该权限的玩家均可修改商店的名称。 quickshop-hikari.set_benefit 任何拥有该权限的玩家均可修改商店的额外收费比例。
caution 如果组权限配置不当，插件可能会停止工作。 打开 group.yml，你就可以分组编辑插件权限。 你不能删除 quickshop-hikari.everyone, quickshop-hikari.staff 和 quickshop-hikari.administrator 组。 这可能会让插件无法正常工作。
看向商店并输入命令 /quickshop permission user set <player> <group>，然后玩家就会被分配至新组。 如果玩家已经处于其他权限组中，则他会被移出旧组。 你也可以输入命令 /quickshop permission user unset <player> 将玩家重新分配回默认组。

documents.t: QuickShop 的价格限制功能允许你设置服务器上某个物品的最高与最低价格。 price-restriction.yml 文件可以编辑限制规则。
该功能默认禁用。 请在编辑规则之前将其启用。 enable: true

You can set separate minimum and maximum prices for selling and buying shops. global: # These options are always enabled and are not controlled by the enable option selling: min: 0.01 # Can be zero if you want player create a free shop max: -1 # Actually this can be up to 1.7976931348623157E308 buying: min: 0.01 max: -1

所有规则都位于配置的 rules 部分。 You can set the default scope for rules that do not define their own scope. default-rule-scope: BUYING_AND_SELLING Available scopes are BUYING, SELLING, and BUYING_AND_SELLING. rules: # Rules set example1: # Rules name, used for identifier and permission node (quickshop.price.restriction.bypass.<name>) items: - STONE_SWORD - STONE_PICKAXE - STONE_AXE - STONE_SHOVEL - STONE_HOE currency: - '*' scope: BUYING_AND_SELLING min: 1.0 max: 50.0 example2: items: - GOLDEN_SWORD - GOLDEN_PICKAXE - GOLDEN_AXE - GOLDEN_SHOVEL - GOLDEN_HOE currency: - '*' scope: SELLING min: 10.0 max: 100.0 example3: items: - DIAMOND_SWORD - DIAMOND_PICKAXE - DIAMOND_AXE - DIAMOND_SHOVEL - DIAMOND_HOE currency: - '*' scope: BUYING min: 10.0 max: 100.0 example1 和 example2 是规则名称。 可以用任何不重复的名称指代。 scope controls whether the rule applies to buying shops, selling shops, or both. If it is not provided, default-rule-scope is used. items 是该规则适用的物品列表。 物品名称可以是： Bukkit 材料名 物品引用标签（添加 @ 前缀） currency 只能在多经济模式下使用。 min 是物品的最低价格。 max 是物品的最高价格。 同一规则下所有物品共享价格限制。 若需要分配不同的限制，请新建一条规则。
QuickShop 现在支持物品配置中使用通配符。 这使得你可以通过简化的配置设置更多的物品，无需逐个列出。
documents.s: 🆕 在项目黑名单中支持通配符（6.2.0.11+）

documents.t: 内容 含义 * 匹配任意数量字符 ? 匹配单个字符
物品的匹配不需要区分大小写。 *_axe *_AXE 这两条功能相同。
你可以将如下写法： items: - WOODEN_AXE - STONE_AXE - IRON_AXE - GOLDEN_AXE - DIAMOND_AXE - NETHERITE_AXE 简化为： items: - "*_AXE"
选择所有刷怪蛋： items: - "*_SPAWN_EGG" 选择所有类型的剑： items: - "*_SWORD" 单字符匹配： items: - "DIAMOND_SPAWN_EG?"
通配符只能用于材料名称。 不会替换物品引用（@reference）匹配。 规则匹配时解析内容。 通配符可以简化配置，提升可维护性。
玩家拥有： quickshop.price.restriction.bypass.<rule-name> 时，可以无视规则限制。
QuickShop-Hikari includes several layers of protection to prevent shop containers and signs from being damaged, accessed, or modified in unintended ways.

By default, players who do not own a shop or have the required permissions cannot remove another player's shop. QuickShop can also lock shop containers to prevent unauthorized players from opening the container, adding items, or removing items. This behavior is controlled by: shop: # Lock shop containers from non-owners. # This prevents players from stealing from them. lock: true Setting: shop: lock: false disables QuickShop's normal container locking behavior.

QuickShop can protect shops from several environmental and inventory-transfer behaviors, including: explosions; hopper transfers; dropper transfers; entity-related damage; copper oxidation. The protected behaviors are illustrated below: 方块 实体 爆炸 Hopper (includes Hopper Minecart) These protections are configured under the top-level: protect: section in config.yml. The current default configuration is: protect: explode: true hopper: true hopper-owner-exclude: false dropper: true dropper-owner-exclude: false entity: true oxidation: true
protect: explode: true When enabled, QuickShop protects shop blocks from explosion-related destruction. Set it to: protect: explode: false to disable QuickShop's explosion protection.

protect: hopper: true When enabled, QuickShop protects shop inventories from unauthorized hopper-based item transfers. This includes hopper-related inventory movement that could otherwise insert items into or extract items from a shop container.

The related option: protect: hopper-owner-exclude: false controls whether hopper protection should exclude hoppers belonging to the shop owner. With the default: hopper-owner-exclude: false QuickShop continues applying its hopper protection normally. Set: hopper-owner-exclude: true when shop-owner hoppers should be excluded from this protection.

protect: dropper: true When enabled, QuickShop protects shop inventories from dropper-based item transfers. This prevents droppers from being used to bypass the normal protections surrounding a shop's inventory.

Dropper protection has its own owner-exclusion option: protect: dropper-owner-exclude: false With the default: dropper-owner-exclude: false QuickShop applies dropper protection normally. Set: dropper-owner-exclude: true when droppers belonging to the shop owner should be excluded from the protection. note hopper-owner-exclude and dropper-owner-exclude are independent settings. Allowing an owner's hopper does not automatically allow an owner's dropper, and vice versa.
protect: entity: true When enabled, QuickShop protects shop blocks from entity-related destruction or modification handled by the shop protection system. Set it to false to disable this protection.

protect: oxidation: true When enabled, QuickShop prevents copper shop containers from naturally oxidizing while they are being used as shops. This keeps the copper block in the state it had when used for the shop instead of allowing normal oxidation to change the block over time. Set: protect: oxidation: false if copper shop blocks should be allowed to oxidize normally. info Oxidation protection is only relevant to shop blocks that support Minecraft's copper oxidation behavior.

A typical configuration with all protection types enabled is: protect: explode: true hopper: true hopper-owner-exclude: false dropper: true dropper-owner-exclude: false entity: true oxidation: true Each protection can be configured independently.

QuickShop also includes a protection checker used when determining whether a player is allowed to create or interact with a shop in a protected area. By default, QuickShop sends a simulated BlockBreakEvent to determine whether another protection plugin permits the player to modify the block. shop: protection-checking: true This helps QuickShop work with protection systems even when a dedicated compatibility module is not installed. caution Disabling protection checking is not recommended unless you are using another integration or protection mechanism that reliably handles shop placement. Without protection checking, players may be able to create shops on containers inside regions, claims, towns, plots, spawn areas, or other locations where they normally cannot modify blocks. To disable the generic protection checker: shop: protection-checking: false

Protection checking can be disabled in specific worlds: shop: protection-checking-blacklist: - disabled_world This is useful when a world does not use region protection or when a specific protection integration should handle checks instead.

QuickShop's simulated protection events may conflict with some plugins or listeners. Specific listeners can be excluded with: shop: protection-checking-listener-blacklist: - ignored_listener Entries can target a listener class, class prefix, plugin, or supported regular-expression pattern. For example, an entire plugin can be excluded with: shop: protection-checking-listener-blacklist: - "@PluginName" Or a specific listener can be excluded: shop: protection-checking-listener-blacklist: - "com.example.protection.BlockBreakListener"

QuickShop-Hikari's shop protection system can protect shops from: Protection Setting Explosions protect.explode Hopper transfers protect.hopper Owner hopper exclusion protect.hopper-owner-exclude Dropper transfers protect.dropper Owner dropper exclusion protect.dropper-owner-exclude Entity-related damage protect.entity Copper oxidation protect.oxidation For most servers, keeping these protections enabled provides the safest default behavior.
QuickShop 会用到一个 Protection Checker 的机制阻止玩家在没有权限的地方（例如主城）创建商店。
玩家尝试创建商店时，QuickShop 会模拟一个 BlockBreakEvent，假装以玩家身份试图破坏方块。 如果任何插件拦截了这个事件，那么 QuickShop 不会让玩家创建商店。
部分不兼容 QuickShop 的插件可能会在玩家手持物品时意外触发，或频繁阻止商店创建。

当 QuickShop 在服务器管理员执行的操作过程中检测到可能的冲突时，管理员会收到如下消息： 可以从这段文本中得知： 插件名称（BreakTest） 插件监听类名（com.ghsotchu.test.breaktest.TestListener） 要解决冲突，请将其添加至忽略列表： shop: # 检查保护时跳过的监听器 # 示例： # - xx.xxx.xxx.xxxxx.BlockBreakListenerClass # 这会跳过 xx.xxx.xxx.xxxxx.BlockBreakListenerClass 的监听器调用。 # # - xx.xx.xxx.xxxxx # 跳过以 xx.xx.xxx.xxxxx 开头的监听器类名。 # # - @插件名称 # 跳过此插件的所有监听器。 # # - 正则表达式 # 同样支持正则表达式。 protection-checking-listener-blacklist: - ignored_listener 你也可以通过插件名称阻止对应插件收到我们的模拟事件： shop: protection-checking-listener-blacklist: - "@BreakTest" 或者只阻止一个监听器，防止它收到我们的模拟事件： shop: protection-checking-listener-blacklist: - "com.ghsotchu.test.breaktest.TestListener"

caution 非常不推荐禁用保护检查，有心玩家可能会利用 QuickShop 的机制锁上其他玩家在 Residence、Land、空岛、WorldGuard 区域、城镇、地皮甚至是主城中的容器！ 直接关闭 config.yml 中的选项即可： shop: # 保护检查 # 发送虚拟的 BlockBreakEvent，检查你是否能破坏某个方块。 # 可能会与其他保护插件冲突！ # 兼容检查晚于该功能发送，若其与联动插件产生冲突，请禁用此设置 # 若不需要，请将其禁用，并使用下方的兼容设置。 protection-checking: true 或者只是明确地在某个世界禁用： shop: # 禁用保护检查的世界列表。 protection-checking-blacklist: - disabled_world
QuickShop 提供了一个等级系统，控制玩家可以拥有的商店数量上限。
此功能基于权限，且权限会动态生成。

# 限制玩家可以创建和拥有的商店数量。 limits: # 若你不需要这个功能，请将其留空！QuickShop 会忽略剩余部分的配置。 use: true # 玩家可以创建商店的默认数量。 default: 10 # 无限商店参与上限计算时是否使用旧算法。 old-algorithm: false # 这里你可以将限制绑定到指定权限。 # 按照格式可无限添加！ ranks: quickshoplol: # 父节点 # 拥有 quickshop.example 权限的玩家可以创建 20 个商店。 supervip: 20 # 子节点

在上面的示例中，所有玩家默认的商店上限是 10。但，拥有 quickshoplol.supervip 的玩家可以拥有 20 个商店。 基本上就是用 <node parent>.<node child> 生成的权限节点，你可以将 quickshoplol 和 supervip 替换成任意内容。 # 限制玩家可以创建和拥有的商店数量。 limits: # 若你不需要这个功能，请将其留空！QuickShop 会忽略剩余部分的配置。 use: true # 玩家可以创建商店的默认数量。 default: 10 # 无限商店参与上限计算时是否使用旧算法。 old-algorithm: false # 这里你可以将限制绑定到指定权限。 # 按照格式可无限添加！ ranks: linustechtips: # 父节点 # 拥有 quickshop.example 权限的玩家可以创建 20 个商店。 cotton: 12345 # 子节点 本示例中，拥有 linustechtips.cotton 权限的玩家可以至多创建 12345 个商店。
QuickShop 没有限制绕过权限，你可以将上限设置为像 99999999 这样的足够大的数字。 当玩家拥有多个等级时，QuickShop 会取最大值（商店数量更多的那一个）。
如果您有大量商店需要移除，以下方法可以帮您很快完成。
从 Modrinth安装Compat-WorldEdit，然后选择您想要删除的商店，输入 //set 0 命令即可。
如果需要删除你自己创建的所有商店，只需执行 /quickshopp removeall，这样你的所有商店就会删除。 要移除某个玩家的商店，让服务器管理员执行 /quickshop removeall <player>，这样这个玩家的所有商店将会被移除。
documents.s: 移除某玩家的所有商店

documents.t: 本章节将会指导你如何创建 QuickShop 商店，并与之交互。
首先，你需要放置一个商店容器（如箱子），在生存模式下左键点击容器，QuickShop 就会弹出提醒要求你输入价格。 在聊天栏输入 10，那么你就成功创建了一个出售价格为 10 的商店。 在聊天栏输入价格 创建商店 设置商店后，其他玩家可以左键点击商店购买物品。
只需将出售的同类物品放入商店容器中，即可完成补货！ 将物品放入容器 补充后的商店
左键点击商店告示牌，聊天栏会出现控制面板。 点击 商店模式：出售 [点击切换] 按钮，你的商店就会变成收购模式！ 点击 [点击切换] 按钮 切换模式后的商店
documents.s: 将商店切换为收购模式

documents.t: 左键点击商店告示牌，聊天栏会出现控制面板。 点击 冻结模式：✘ [点击切换] 按钮，你的商店就会变成冻结模式！ 点击 [点击切换] 按钮 切换冻结模式后的商店
documents.s: 将商店切换为冻结模式

documents.t: 与补充库存相同，只需将物品从商店中取出即可腾出空间。
商店名称可个性化，交易日志中的商店位置会被替换为重命名后的商店名称。 看向商店，输入命令 /quickshop name <name> 即可重命名。
创建商店后，你可以通过控制面板改变商店价格。 看向商店，点击 价格：xx [修改] 按钮，然后在聊天栏中输入新价格即可。
只需破坏商店容器或通过控制面板删除即可。
为了防止欺骗，QuickShop 允许玩家浏览商店正在出售或收购的物品。 点击商店，弹出交易面板后，点击 [预览物品]，物品的名称和描述就会显示。 你可以点击 [预览物品] 打开展示物品的菜单。
不只是箱子，其他所有原版容器都可以用来创建 QuickShop 商店！

config.yml 中可自由修改用于开设商店的方块： # 可以用于创建商店的方块。 # 默认情况下箱子也处于列表中。 # 只会对实现了 InventoryHolder 的方块有效！ # 换句话说，你不能用诸如泥土或石头的普通方块创建商店。 # 部分方块可能会有非预期行为...例如： # - 漏斗会将展示物品吸走， # - 熔炉允许玩家在三个格子里放任意物品， # - 发射器商店不会阻止红石激活， # - 等等... shop-blocks: - CHEST - TRAPPED_CHEST - BARREL - BLAST_FURNACE - FURNACE - BREWING_STAND - DISPENSER - DROPPER - HOPPER - SMOKER shop-blocks 列表不支持物品引用，你只能在这里使用 Bukkit 材料名。
QuickShop 允许服务器管理员配置创建商店和改变价格的费用。

shop: # 创建商店的费用。设置为 0 表示免费。 cost: 10 # 是否在玩家的商店被破坏/删除时返还费用？ refund: false # 是否从税收账户退款？ # 尽可能满足退款要求；如果账户余额不足，玩家可能不会收到所有退还款项。 refund-from-tax-account: false # 修改商店价格是否收费？ # 有助于缓解频繁改价带来的价格战。 price-change-requires-fee: true # 修改商店价格的费用。 fee-for-price-change: 50 # 修改商店名称的费用。 name-fee: 0 # 商店名称的最大长度。 name-max-length: 32 # 商店维护费用。 # 若店主无力支付，则商店即日移除。 ongoing-fee: enable: false # 维护费允许最长拖欠多久？ ticks: 42000 # 每个商店收取多少维护费？ cost-per-shop: 2 # 是否不对无限商店计费？ ignore-unlimited: true
它由 shop.cost 控制，设置为 0 表示免费。 shop.refund 启用后即可在商店删除或被破坏时退还创建费用。 若需要从 QuickShop 收税账户退款，那么还需要启用 shop.refund-from-tax-account。 如果税务帐户没有足够的钱，玩家可能无法收到退款。
防止玩家频繁改变商店价格，只需开启 shop.price-change-requires-fee 即可。 启用后，玩家每次更改价格都会被收取 shop.fee-for-price-change 对应的金额。
将 shop.name-fee 设置为非零值，可让玩家付费修改商店名称。 玩家只有支付费用后才可修改商店名称。
防止玩家通过大量商店破坏市场平衡，你可以启用这个功能。 启用后，玩家每 shop.ongoing-fee.ticks 刻就需要为每个商店支付 shop.ongoing-fee.cost-per-shop 设置的维护费。 如果玩家无力支付费用，那么商店就会被删除。
QuickShop 有一个可配置的税收系统。

# 税收百分比（小数） # 例如：玩家甲从乙处购买了价值 50$ 的物品，那么甲支付 50$，而乙赚了 (1-0.05)*50$，税收账户收取 0.05*50$。 tax: 0.05 # 税款流向的虚拟账户。 # 将其设置为 "" 可禁用（税收功能仍然有效，但会直接销毁） tax-account: tax # 是否禁用无限商店的税收 tax-free-for-unlimited-shop: false # 是否在交易后显示收取的税 show-tax: false
每次交易都会拿出一小部分充当税收，由 tax` 选项控制。 1 表示 100%，而 0.05 则表示 5%，你需要自行将小数与百分比进行转化。 你也可以启用 show-tax 选项，使得玩家可以在交易时看到收取的税。
默认情况下，所有税款都会流入名为 tax 的账户。 根据你的服务器经济插件及玩法设计差异，默认设置可能不完全适合你，需要修改它。 tax-account 可填入玩家名称或 uuid。
商店历史记录系统允许玩家与店员在菜单界面中浏览过去的交易记录。 它提供了完整的交易信息，包括： 买家 物品 数量 价格 税 时间戳 商店所在位置 商店摘要统计 历史界面是菜单系统的一部分，可以在 gui.yml 中自定义 引用： 本地化通过 messages.yml 进行
右键点击商店。 打开控制面板。 点击历史按钮。 这能打开指定商店的历史记录列表。
你可以通过命令查询历史记录：/quickshop history <sub-command> 可用的子命令： owned — 查看拥有的商店历史记录。 accessible — 查看拥有访问权限的商店。 global — 选择全服商店（需要额外权限）。 这对较大规模商店的店主或员工非常有用。
历史菜单可以分页显示不同的交易记录条目。 每个条目都代表着一次已经完成的交易。
鼠标移动到条目上会显示： 交易时间 买家（玩家名称） 物品及数量 总价 收取的税 （若存在多家商店）具体坐标 若正在查询多个商店： 玩家头颅图标可能会被商店物品代替。 位置数据会显示在条目详细信息中。
历史菜单左上角显示如下内容： 总购买数 不重复买家数量 总交易额 可以快速浏览商店的营业状况。
右上角的钻石图标会显示： 前五名消费最高的玩家 按交易总额排序 适用于： 福利系统 VIP 记录 玩家分析
使用权限取决于情境： 商店拥有者 → 可以浏览自己拥有商店的历史。 店员 → 若有权限则可浏览。 管理员 → 可通过命令浏览全局历史。 如果玩家无法打开历史记录，请检查： QuickShop 权限 商店访问权限 店员配置
你可以修改： 菜单标题 菜单布局 导航按钮 概述物品 交易条目格式 分页 所有布局设置都可以在 gui.yml 修改 引用： 文本和按钮名称支持本地化的 lang: 前缀： name: "lang:history.title" 会从 messages.yml 读取内容
允许玩家浏览历史记录，可提高经济系统溯源性。 允许店员浏览 global 历史记录，方便管理。 使用汇总统计监测不活跃或可疑的商店。 与新税收系统结合，可更全面追踪交易。
商店历史记录系统提供： 完整的交易审计 一或多家商店查询 菜单浏览 摘要分析 高消费人群跟踪 完全自定义 非常建议经济发达的服务器使用此功能。
商店清理允许管理员自动清理长期不活跃的商店或被封禁玩家的商店。

# 商店清理 # 使用命令或在服务器启动后，自动删除离线超 x 天的所有商店 purge: enabled: false # 是否在服务器启动时自动清理商店。 at-server-setup: true # 是否在清理前进行备份 backup: true # 多久不上线玩家的商店会被清理，单位为天。 days: 60 # QuickShop 目前只与原版的封禁系统（例如 Essentials 使用的）兼容 banned: true # QuickShop 目前只与原版的管理员系统兼容；之后可能会添加 LuckPerms 支持。 skip-op: true # 当商店被服务器清理且服务器设置了创建商店收费，是否退还玩家创建费用？ return-create--fee: true 封禁玩家自动清理目前只支持原版的封禁系统，尚不支持诸如 LiteBans 或 AdvancedBan 这样的第三方封禁系统。
QuickShop 有一个内置的商店搜索功能，可以在不加载区块的情况下搜索服务器的商店。
只需输入命令 /quickshop find <itemname> 即可。
目前物品名称只支持输入英文，尚不支持其他国家的语言！
[QuickShop Addon] Ronsane 的商店搜索插件拓展可以在 SpigotMC 上下载，提供了高级商店搜索功能。

QuickShop-Hikari 6.3.0.0 introduces Shop States as a separate system from Shop Types. A shop type answers: What kind of trade does this shop perform? A shop state answers: What operational condition is this shop currently in? This change allows a shop to remain a BUYING or SELLING shop while being temporarily frozen.

QuickShop currently provides two built-in states: State Identifier Trading Allowed Active active Yes Frozen frozen No Every shop therefore has both a type and a state. For example: Type: SELLING State: active or: Type: SELLING State: frozen The second shop remains a selling shop even though trading is temporarily disabled.

The normal state is: active An active shop allows normal trading according to its shop type. For example: Type: BUYING State: active allows players to sell items to the shop. The built-in ActiveState does not override the shop type's normal sign/trading text.

The frozen state is: frozen A frozen shop: remains registered as its original shop type; keeps its item, price, owner, inventory, and other shop data; blocks player trading; reports itself as frozen to QuickShop's UI and rendering systems; overrides the normal shop-type trading text where applicable. The built-in Frozen state returns: isTradingAllowed() == false isFrozen() == true and uses: shop-cannot-trade-when-freezing as its blocked-trading translation key.

Before 6.3.0.0, freezing was represented through a dedicated FrozenType. That mixed two different concepts: Trade direction Operational condition For example, changing: BUYING → FROZEN meant the shop temporarily lost its normal type identity. With Shop States, QuickShop instead stores: Type: BUYING State: frozen When unfrozen, only the state changes: Type: BUYING State: active The shop's underlying trade type never needs to be reconstructed. This is also more extensible for custom shop types, because every custom type can use the same state system.

The existing freeze command now toggles the shop's state: /qs freeze When an active shop is frozen, QuickShop changes its state to: frozen Running the command again changes it back to: active The shop type remains unchanged throughout the process. For example: Before: /qs freeze Type: SELLING State: active becomes: Type: SELLING State: frozen and after running /qs freeze again: Type: SELLING State: active

Freezing a shop is controlled through QuickShop's shop permission system. The freeze command checks the shop-level permission represented by: SET_SHOP_STATE Users with the administrative bypass: quickshop.other.freeze can also change the frozen state of shops they do not normally manage.

A state can decide whether it should override the shop type's normal text. The ShopState API exposes: boolean overrideShopTypeText(); The built-in states behave as follows: State Overrides Type Text Active No Frozen Yes This allows a frozen buying or selling shop to display frozen text without changing its underlying shop type. This behavior is also used by QuickShop's configurable sign layout system.

Shop states implement: ShopState The interface includes: String identifier(); String translationKey(); String miniLoreTranslationKey(); boolean overrideShopTypeText(); boolean isTradingAllowed(); boolean isFrozen(); String blockedReasonTranslationKey(); A shop's current state can be accessed through: ShopState state = shop.shopState(); Common checks include: if(!shop.shopState().isTradingAllowed()) { // Trading is currently unavailable } or: if(shop.shopState().isFrozen()) { // Shop is frozen } Prefer capability-style checks such as: isTradingAllowed() over checking only for the literal identifier when your addon only needs to know whether a trade may occur. That allows future states to block trading without requiring every integration to know each state name.

The current state can be changed through the shop API: shop.shopState(newState); QuickShop's built-in freeze command switches between the registered Active and Frozen state instances. When writing addons, prefer retrieving states through QuickShop's state registration/management APIs rather than constructing assumptions around the deprecated FrozenType.

The ShopManager exposes state lookup methods for registered states. For example, integrations can work with state identifiers such as: active frozen This makes the state system extensible in the same way that QuickShop's shop-type system can support additional implementations.

QuickShop's ShopQuery system also supports filtering by: ShopState through its state filter. This allows addons to query collections such as: all active shops all frozen shops independently from whether those shops are buying or selling. That separation makes queries such as: all frozen BUYING shops possible by combining a type filter with a state filter.

A useful way to think about the new model is: Shop Type = what the shop does Shop State = whether/how the shop is currently operating For example: Type State Result SELLING active Players can buy from the shop SELLING frozen Selling behavior is preserved, trading blocked BUYING active Players can sell to the shop BUYING frozen Buying behavior is preserved, trading blocked

The ShopState interface is designed to support additional states. A custom state can define: its stable identifier; its display translation; miniature lore text; whether it overrides shop-type text; whether trading is allowed; whether it should be treated as frozen; the reason shown when trading is blocked. This allows future or addon-defined states such as maintenance or disabled states without creating new shop types for each operational condition.

Shop States separate a shop's current condition from its trade behavior. QuickShop-Hikari 6.3.0.0 uses: active frozen as its built-in states, while normal trade types remain: SELLING BUYING The key result is that freezing a shop no longer destroys or replaces its original buying/selling identity.

QuickShop-Hikari uses shop types to define the direction of a shop's trade. 内置的商店类型： SELLING BUYING info Starting with QuickShop-Hikari 6.3.0.0, Frozen is no longer a normal shop type. Freezing is now represented by a Shop State, allowing a shop to remain either SELLING or BUYING while its current state controls whether trading is allowed.

A SELLING shop sells items from the shop to the player. Players: pay money to the shop; receive the configured item. The built-in identifier is: SELLING QuickShop uses the selling shop's inventory stock when determining how many trades remain available. For example, if the shop contains 64 diamonds and trades one diamond at a time, its remaining stock is based on those available diamonds.

A BUYING shop buys items from the player. Players: give items to the shop; receive money from the shop. The built-in identifier is: BUYING Unlike a selling shop, a buying shop's remaining capacity is based on the amount of free inventory space available for the item being purchased. This makes buying shops useful for: resource collection; server buy-back systems; material sinks; automated collection shops.

Shop types and shop states now represent different concerns. Property Shop Type Shop State Purpose Defines trade direction and behavior Defines the shop's current operational condition Built-in examples SELLING, BUYING active, frozen Changes money/item flow Yes Usually no Can block trading Type API supports it, but normal freezing is now state-based Yes Example Shop buys diamonds Buying shop is temporarily frozen A shop therefore has both values at the same time. For example: Type: BUYING State: active means the shop is currently buying items normally. Type: BUYING State: frozen means the shop is still fundamentally a buying shop, but trading is temporarily blocked. When the shop is unfrozen, it returns to: Type: BUYING State: active without needing to restore or infer its previous trade type. See Shop States for details.

Shop owners or authorized staff can switch between buying and selling behavior through QuickShop's normal shop-management controls. Changing the shop type affects the direction of the transaction: SELLING → player buys from shop BUYING → player sells to shop Freezing should not be treated as a type change. To temporarily stop trading, use the shop's state instead.

The API still contains the legacy: FrozenType class for compatibility with older code. However, as of 6.3.0.0 it is: @Deprecated(since = "6.3.0.0", forRemoval = true) New addons and integrations should not use FrozenType to freeze a shop. Use the ShopState API instead.

Shop types implement: IShopType The interface defines information such as: int id(); String identifier(); String translationKey(); boolean isBuying(); boolean isStackable(); boolean isTradingBlocked(); Integer remainingStock(Shop shop); CompletableFuture<Integer> remainingStockAsync(Shop shop); A shop's current type can be accessed through: IShopType type = shop.shopType(); Common checks include: if(shop.shopType().isBuying()) { // Buying shop } or: if(shop.shopType().identifier().equalsIgnoreCase("SELLING")) { // Selling shop } Where possible, addons should work with the IShopType abstraction instead of depending directly on built-in implementation classes.
Shop Type Numeric ID Identifier 出售 0 SELLING 收购 1 BUYING The old Frozen type used numeric ID 2, but it is deprecated in 6.3.0.0 and should not be used for new implementations.

QuickShop's type system is extensible through IShopType. A custom shop type can define its own: identifier; translation keys; operation type; buying/selling semantics; stacking support; remaining-stock calculation; asynchronous stock calculation. Shop states remain separate from these behaviors. This separation allows an addon-defined shop type to also become active or frozen without requiring a separate frozen version of every custom type.

QuickShop-Hikari's normal built-in shop types are now: SELLING BUYING Frozen is no longer the shop's trade type. It is a Shop State. This means the shop's underlying buying or selling behavior is preserved while the state independently controls whether that shop is currently allowed to trade.

QuickShop-Hikari allows you to customize the contents of shop signs through the RenderComponent system. QuickShop-Hikari 6.3 expands the sign layout system so that sign lines can use built-in full-line components or inline components that can be combined with your own text. This makes it possible to keep the traditional QuickShop sign layout or create more customized sign formats.

Shop sign layouts are configured in config.yml under: shop: layout: The default layout is: shop: layout: BUYING: line1: "header" line2: "trading" line3: "item" line4: "price" FROZEN: line1: "header" line2: "trading" line3: "item" line4: "price" SELLING: line1: "header" line2: "trading" line3: "item" line4: "price" Each shop state can use its own four-line layout.

QuickShop-Hikari 6.3 introduces a unified RenderComponent system for rendering shop information. RenderComponents are divided into three types: Full-line components — generate an entire formatted sign line. Inline components — replace only themselves and can be combined with surrounding text. Conditional components — inline components whose output changes depending on the shop's current state.
Full-line components retain the traditional QuickShop sign layout behavior.
Displays the shop header. line1: "header" The exact text and formatting are determined by QuickShop's localization and shop state.
Displays the shop's trading or stock information. line2: "trading"
Displays the formatted shop item. line3: "item"
Displays applicable item level information. line3: "level" This can include information such as: enchantment levels; potion duration; other supported item-level information.

Displays the complete formatted price line. line4: "price" The price full-line component automatically uses QuickShop's normal price formatting, including support for applicable stacking-shop formatting.

Inline components can be placed inside a sign line and combined with normal text. 例如： line1: "<owner>" line2: "<item_name>" line3: "<type> <amount>" line4: "<price_amount>" Unlike full-line components, inline components only replace their placeholder.
Displays the amount of the item being traded. line2: "Amount: <amount>"
Displays the shop item's name. line2: "<item_name>"
Displays applicable item-level information. line3: "<item_level>" Depending on the item, this may represent information such as an enchantment level or potion duration.
Displays the shop owner's name. line1: "<owner>"
Displays only the formatted shop price. line4: "<price_alone>" The full-line price component remains separate and uses QuickShop's complete sign price formatting.
Displays the formatted shop price together with the applicable trade amount formatting. line4: "<price_amount>" This is useful when creating a custom version of QuickShop's normal price line.
Displays the shop's current state or status. line2: "<status>"
Displays the shop's current stock information. line3: "Stock: <stock>"
Displays the shop type. line2: "<type>" This can be used to identify whether the shop is buying, selling, or another supported shop type.
Conditional components determine their output based on the current shop state.

amount_auto automatically represents the shop's available stock state. line3: "<amount_auto>" Depending on the shop, it can display: the remaining stock amount; an out-of-stock state; an unlimited-stock state. This allows one layout to handle multiple stock conditions without requiring separate configuration.

The default layout uses only full-line components: shop: layout: SELLING: line1: "header" line2: "trading" line3: "item" line4: "price" This preserves QuickShop's traditional sign appearance while using the new rendering system internally.

You can instead construct your own sign lines using inline components: shop: layout: SELLING: line1: "<owner>" line2: "<item_name>" line3: "Stock: <amount_auto>" line4: "<price_amount>" This provides direct control over which pieces of shop information appear on each line.

BUYING, SELLING, and FROZEN shops can each use different layouts. For example: shop: layout: SELLING: line1: "<owner>" line2: "<item_name>" line3: "Sell <amount>" line4: "<price_amount>" BUYING: line1: "<owner>" line2: "<item_name>" line3: "Buy <amount>" line4: "<price_amount>" FROZEN: line1: "header" line2: "<status>" line3: "<item_name>" line4: "<price_alone>" This makes it easier for players to visually distinguish different shop states.
A sign line can be left empty: line4: "" For example: shop: layout: SELLING: line1: "<item_name>" line2: "<price_amount>" line3: "" line4: "" This can be useful for minimalist layouts.

Inline components can be combined with normal text: line1: "Owner: <owner>" line2: "<item_name>" line3: "Stock: <amount_auto>" line4: "Price: <price_alone>" Keep in mind that Minecraft signs have limited horizontal space. Long owner names, item names, or currency formats may make heavily customized lines difficult to read.

Full-line components and inline components serve different purposes. Use a full-line component when you want QuickShop to generate and format the complete line: line4: "price" Use an inline component when you want to control the rest of the line yourself: line4: "Price: <price_alone>" For most servers, the default full-line components provide the simplest and most compatible layout. Inline components are useful when you want a more customized sign appearance.

QuickShop-Hikari 6.3 adds level as a full-line sign layout option. For example: shop: layout: SELLING: line1: "header" line2: "item" line3: "level" line4: "price" This can provide additional information for items where a level or duration is important, such as enchanted items or potions. If you need the same value as part of a custom line, use: <item_level>

New shops use the configured layout when their signs are rendered. Existing shops must have their signs refreshed before changes become visible. Depending on your server setup, this may occur when the shop is updated, reloaded, or otherwise causes QuickShop to refresh its sign. If you are making significant layout changes, test the layout on a small number of shops before deploying it across a large server.

Minecraft shop signs are still limited to four lines. RenderComponents allow more control over the contents of those lines, but they do not increase the number of available sign lines. Also keep the physical width of Minecraft signs in mind. A technically valid layout may still become difficult to read if too much information is placed on one line.

The same RenderComponent system is also used by QuickShop's Text Display feature. Text Displays provide substantially more room and visual customization than Minecraft signs. note Text Displays currently only work when using: shop: display-type: 3 See Text Displays for Text Display configuration and examples.

shop: layout: SELLING: line1: "<owner>" line2: "<item_name>" line3: "<amount_auto>" line4: "<price_amount>" BUYING: line1: "<owner>" line2: "<item_name>" line3: "<amount_auto>" line4: "<price_amount>" FROZEN: line1: "header" line2: "<status>" line3: "<item_name>" line4: "<price_alone>"

shop: layout: SELLING: line1: "header" line2: "item" line3: "level" line4: "price" BUYING: line1: "header" line2: "item" line3: "level" line4: "price" FROZEN: line1: "header" line2: "trading" line3: "item" line4: "price"

documents.t: QuickShop-Hikari 6.3's sign rendering system supports both the traditional layout components and more flexible inline RenderComponents. The main full-line components are: header trading item level price The available inline and conditional components include: <amount> <amount_auto> <item_name> <item_level> <owner> <price_alone> <price_amount> <status> <stock> <type> Use full-line components for QuickShop's standard formatting and inline components when you want to construct custom sign lines yourself.

# 贴墙告示牌材料。 #ACACIA_WALL_SIGN #BIRCH_WALL_SIGN #DARK_OAK_WALL_SIGN #JUNGLE_WALL_SIGN #OAK_WALL_SIGN #SPRUCE_WALL_SIGN sign-material: OAK_WALL_SIGN

QuickShop 可以为商店告示牌自动打蜡，防止玩家手动编辑其上内容。 为告示牌打蜡可以保护你的商店告示牌，可以防止其他玩家有意或无意的修改。 新版本的 Minecraft 中，打蜡的告示牌本身需要先除蜡，否则无法编辑。
Minecraft 中，给告示牌打蜡相当于将其锁定： 玩家无法编辑其上的文本 玩家也无法改变文本行的内容 防止无意改动 防止恶意改动 在 QuickShop 中启用后，商店告示牌会在创建后自动打蜡。
告示牌打蜡可以防止： 玩家编辑价格 修改告示牌上出售物品的名称 防止恶意篡改 防止非预期的格式问题 防止被其他玩家修改 非常建议公开服务器使用此功能。
创建商店时： QuickShop 生成商店告示牌。 生成告示牌文本。 （若启用）为告示牌自动打蜡。 若商店更新： 告示牌由 QuickShop 安全刷新。 保持打蜡状态。 被打蜡的告示牌无法被玩家手动编辑。
若需要切换告示牌打蜡功能，请打开 config.yml，找到： shop: sign-wax: true
自动为商店告示牌打蜡。 玩家无法手动编辑告示牌。
商店与一般告示牌无异。 玩家可以在有权限的情况下编辑其内容。
对于大多数服务器： shop: sign-wax: true 可以确保商店数据准确安全。
QuickShop 会控制商店告示牌格式。 不推荐手动编辑。 管理员应使用： 控制面板 商店命令 直接修改配置

在生存服务器上保持开启告示牌打蜡。 将打蜡机制与对应权限结合使用。 避免使用其他插件编辑告示牌。
